title: Head of Client Management - (B2B, Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We’re hiring a Head of Client Management to lead our core client portfolio and the account management team that serves it. You’ll manage Senior Account Managers and Account Managers, set the service standards every client in the portfolio receives, and serve as the single point of accountability for client experience, retention, and growth. This is a people-leadership role rather than an individual book of business: you’ll coach and develop the team, build the processes that let it serve a high volume of accounts consistently, and stay hands-on for escalations, at-risk accounts, and key renewals. Success is measured by the health of the portfolio and the team behind it: client satisfaction, retention, team performance, and sustainable revenue growth.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Team Leadership & People Management

·	Lead, coach, and develop a team of Senior Account Managers and Account Managers responsible for the core client portfolio.

·	Assign and balance account portfolios across the team based on account volume, complexity, and individual capacity.

·	Set clear performance expectations and run regular one-on-ones, account reviews, and monthly scorecard reviews with each team member.

·	Identify skill gaps and deliver coaching, training, and development plans; manage underperformance through documented coaching and Performance Improvement Plans when required.

·	Partner with leadership and Talent Acquisition on team capacity planning, hiring, and onboarding of new Account Managers.

·	Build a team culture of accountability, client ownership, and continuous improvement.

 

2. Client Management & Experience

·	Own the end-to-end client experience for the core client portfolio from onboarding through renewal.

·	Establish and enforce consistent service standards, client touchpoint cadences, and communication playbooks across the team.

·	Serve as the escalation point for complex client issues, at-risk accounts, and sensitive client relationships.

·	Step in directly on key client relationships, renewals, and recovery conversations where senior involvement is needed.

·	Drive client satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy across the segment through proactive, consistent engagement.

 

3. Portfolio Growth & Value Creation

·	Set segment-level retention and growth targets and translate them into individual targets for each team member.

·	Guide the team in identifying expansion opportunities through additional services, compliance solutions, or operational improvements that create measurable client value.

·	Oversee renewal planning across the portfolio, ensuring renewals are initiated on time and handled with long-term client relationships in mind.

·	Maintain visibility into the team's expansion pipeline and forecast segment growth to leadership.

·	Ensure every recommendation the team makes aligns with the client's business needs and long-term success.

 

4. Portfolio Health & Team Performance Management

·	Own the overall health and performance of the core client portfolio.

·	Monitor client engagement, retention risks, service utilization, and satisfaction trends across the segment and by Account Manager.

·	Direct recovery strategies for at-risk accounts and coordinate cross-functional action plans.

·	Ensure the team maintains accurate account plans, forecasts, client documentation, and CRM records.

·	Report portfolio and team performance metrics to leadership and use insights to drive continuous improvement.

 

5. Cross-Functional Leadership & Process

·	Serve as the core portfolio's central point of coordination with internal teams.

·	Partner closely with Operations, Customer Support, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Sales to ensure a consistent client experience.

·	Build and refine scalable account management processes, playbooks, and workflows that allow the team to serve a high volume of accounts efficiently.

·	Share customer insights to influence product enhancements, service improvements, and organizational priorities.

·	Advocate for client needs while balancing operational capabilities and business objectives.



Required Qualifications:



·	3+ years of Account Management experience in B2B client management, customer success, or client services roles.

·	2+ years of experience directly managing a team of Account Managers, including senior or lead-level Account Managers.

·	Hands-on client management experience owning client relationships, retention, renewals, and escalations.

·	Proven ability to coach, develop, and hold a team accountable to performance targets and service standards.

·	Experience managing a high-volume client portfolio through a team, including portfolio assignment and capacity planning.

·	Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer advocacy, operational excellence, and sustainable revenue growth.

·	Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams to resolve client challenges and deliver measurable business outcomes.

·	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.



Technical Skills:



•	Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar customer relationship management systems.

•	Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret client and team performance metrics, identify trends, and develop strategic recommendations.

•	Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to prepare leadership reports, account reviews, and team performance insights.

•	Demonstrated ability to handle protected health information (PHI) and confidential client data in accordance with HIPAA and MedPro and MP1's information security policies.

•	Reliable high-speed internet, a private and secure workspace, and use of company-issued equipment and VPN for all client and system access.



Leadership Competencies:



•The successful Strategic Account Manager demonstrates: 

•Executive Presence and Professionalism 

•Strategic Thinking 

•Customer-Centric Mindset 

•Consultative Relationship Management 

•Commercial and Business Acumen 

•Strong Negotiation and Influencing Skills 

•Excellent Verbal and Written Communication 

•Problem Solving and Critical Thinking 

•Cross-Functional Collaboration 

•Accountability and Ownership 

•Adaptability and Change Leadership 

•High Emotional Intelligence 



Nice-to-Have:

•	Background in healthcare, healthcare compliance, environmental services, medical waste management, or multi-location service organizations.

•	Professional certifications in Customer Success, Account Management, Project Management, Sales, or Healthcare Compliance (e.g., CCSM, PMP, Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), CHC, CHPC, or equivalent) are an advantage.

•	Familiarity with healthcare regulatory and compliance standards (e.g., OSHA, HIPAA, DOT, EPA, or other healthcare/environmental compliance requirements) is preferred.

•	Experience building, scaling, or restructuring an account management or client success team.



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $1,400–$1,600 base salary per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home

title: Amazon Manager

Who We Are

Sunbelt Products is a small but successful and growing eCommerce company based in Odessa, FL that has been in business for more than 15 years. In 2011 we started in a modest 600 square foot warehouse and over the years have progressively grown into a 25,000 square foot operation. 

We sell our own branded products (Liquid Stands, Pink Power, Sleepavo, HTM Lighting) that are manufactured to our specifications and listed on various channels such as Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Reverb, Target, and our own websites. We fulfill orders in our warehouse and we prepare for and ship products to Amazon and Walmart warehouses for them to fulfill.

Ready for a change? You will be joining a small but highly dynamic, dedicated, and motivated team. We value continuous improvement and are readily open to new ideas and suggestions. Each individual can and does make a difference!

Sunbelt Products is seeking a dedicated Amazon Manager to join our growing team. This role will lead the engagement and the day-to-day business strategy for Amazon. 

The Amazon Channel Manager will create and implement strategic growth plans in collaboration with the whole Channel Management Team. He/She will also be responsible for sustaining and continuous development of the company’s Amazon account. 

The ideal candidate must be highly motivated and an expert in all aspects of Amazon. You’ll be an integral part of the Channel Management Team in assisting on the expansion of our brands and excellent sales.





This position is fully remote and follows a Monday through Friday work schedule with weekends off.

Hire, mentor, develop and coach all direct reports.

title: Senior eCommerce & Marketing Manager ($12M+ Multi-Channel) – REMOTE
description:
Apply using this link: 



Who We Are:

Sunbelt Products is a U.S.-based eCommerce company with more than 15 years in business and over $14 million in annual revenue. We own and operate multiple consumer brands, including Liquid Stands, Pink Power, Sleepavo, and HTM Lighting, selling across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and other online channels.

Our team is distributed between the United States and the Philippines, where we already have more than 10 full-time team members working across different areas of the business.



About the Position:

We are seeking a versatile Senior eCommerce & Marketing Manager to oversee the growth and daily operations of our brands.  You will manage an established remote team of channel and functional managers while owning strategy across both marketplace management and digital marketing.



This is not a narrowly focused marketing role. We are looking for someone who understands the entire eCommerce business: revenue, advertising, conversion, listings, promotions, customer acquisition, profitability, and team execution.



A major focus will be Amazon and our other marketplaces, while also accelerating the growth of our Shopify stores through CRO,
, paid media, SEO, affiliates, social media, and other marketing initiatives.



You should be comfortable leading a team while also getting into the details yourself when needed.



This position is fully remote with a Monday–Friday schedule.



What You Will Do:

* Lead, manage, mentor and develop the Marketing and Channel Management teams.

* Set clear priorities for the team based on company goals, channel performance, revenue opportunities, profitability, and operational needs.

* Create and oversee marketing strategies for Shopify stores, including CRO, SEO, paid advertising,
 marketing, social media, affiliate programs, landing pages, and promotional campaigns.

* Oversee 3rd-party marketplace strategy and execution across Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, and other channels, including listings, pricing, SEO, promotions, advertising, product launches, and issue resolution.

* Review performance data regularly and turn insights into clear action items for the team.

* Ensure marketing and marketplace strategies support revenue growth, gross profit, advertising efficiency, conversion rate improvement, and overall channel performance.

* Maintain a strong, consistent, and positive brand image across all customer touchpoints.

* Create, maintain and improve team SOPs, reporting processes, and workflows to ensure consistent execution, accountability, and efficiency.

* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve marketing, analysis, reporting, and team productivity.





Required Qualifications: 

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or equivalent

* 5+ years of eCommerce and digital marketing experience.

* 2+ years managing an eCommerce or marketing team.

* Strong hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience.

* Proficient in utilizing analytics tools to track, analyze, and optimize campaign performance.

* Experience in managing online campaigns across various platforms (social media,
, PPC).

* Project management experience.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Exclusive full-time commitment: This role requires full professional commitment. Applicants must be willing to end any other employment, part-time work, freelance projects, or consulting engagements before starting. We do not permit ongoing paid work on the side while employed in this role.





Desired Qualifications:

* Strongly preferred: Hands-on experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and 3rd-party marketplace management.

* Hands-on experience managing and growing TikTok Shop, including product listings, promotions, campaigns, affiliate marketing, and overall e-commerce performance.

title: Technical Recruiter (Remote)
description:
Role Overview



Barrister is seeking a motivated and proactive Technical Recruiter to join our

Technician Management & Deployment (TMD) division.

This is a high-volume, outbound recruiting role focused on identifying, screening, and

onboarding qualified field service technicians to support Barrister's nationwide service

requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Success requires someone who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls,

engaging prospective technicians, evaluating technical qualifications, and consistently

moving candidates through the recruiting and onboarding pipeline.



Key Responsibilities



High-Volume Talent Acquisition:

Actively source and recruit qualified field service technicians using job boards, resume

databases, professional networks, referrals, internal resources, and cold outreach.



Candidate Screening:

Conduct telephone interviews to evaluate technical experience, field service

background, communication skills, tools, transportation, availability, geographic

coverage, and overall suitability for available opportunities.



Technical Assessment:

Identify technicians with experience in areas such as desktop and laptop support,

printers, point-of-sale equipment, networking, servers, hardware installation, equipment

replacement, break-fix service, and other IT field services.



Full-Cycle Recruitment:

Move qualified candidates through Barrister's recruiting and onboarding process,

including candidate qualification, testing or skills evaluation, required documentation,

background screening coordination, training, and orientation.



Deployment Support:

Work closely with internal Operations and Technician Assignment teams to understand

technician coverage gaps, open staffing requirements, client needs, and SLA priorities.



Pipeline Management:

Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within Barrister's recruitment

and tracking systems. Follow up consistently with candidates until they complete

title: Freight Coordinator (Carrier-side)
description:
Job Overview



We are looking for a Freight Carrier Virtual Assistant to support a U.S.-based trucking company by finding and booking profitable loads for its trucks. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience using DAT Load Board, Truckstop, or similar platforms to find suitable loads, negotiate rates with brokers, and manage shipments for the company's trucks. The role requires someone who can identify profitable loads, coordinate with drivers and brokers, and keep trucks moving efficiently while minimizing empty miles.



Key Responsibilities

Search load boards such as DAT and Truckstop for available loads that match the company's trucks, lanes, and equipment.

Contact freight brokers to negotiate rates and book loads.

Compare load rates, mileage, deadhead miles, and other costs to identify profitable loads.

Plan loads based on truck locations, availability, equipment type, and delivery schedules.

Coordinate with drivers regarding load details, pickup and delivery appointments, and route information.

Obtain and review rate confirmations and ensure load details are accurate.

Track active loads and follow up with brokers and drivers on shipment updates.

Find backhaul loads and plan the next load to reduce empty miles.

Maintain accurate load records and update the company's TMS or dispatch system.

Communicate delays, cancellations, and other issues to brokers and drivers.



Qualifications

At least 2 years of experience in U.S. trucking load management or dispatching.

Hands-on experience using DAT Load Board, Truckstop, or similar platforms.

Experience searching for, evaluating, and booking loads for a trucking company.

Familiarity with broker rate negotiation, rate per mile, deadhead miles, and truck availability.

Good communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work U.S. business hours.

title: Qualified Funding Specialist
description:
T&E Simple Solutions LLC is a financial solutions company specializing in credit improvement, personal funding, business funding, and financial education.



We help clients strengthen their credit profiles, identify financing opportunities, and access appropriate funding solutions based on their qualifications and financial goals.



We are seeking an experienced Funding Specialist who understands both personal and business financing and can independently evaluate client profiles, develop funding strategies, and manage applications from start to finish.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are looking for someone with hands-on funding experience who understands lender requirements, underwriting guidelines, and strategic funding methods.



Key Responsibilities



1. Credit Profile Analysis & Funding Readiness



Review personal and business credit reports to determine funding eligibility.



Analyze FICO scores, credit utilization, payment history, inquiries, debt-to-income ratios, and existing credit limits.



Identify which clients are funding-ready and which require additional credit improvement.



Recognize potential underwriting issues that could result in denials.



Determine the most appropriate funding options based on the client's financial situation.



Develop customized funding strategies to help clients pursue suitable financing opportunities.



2. Personal Funding



Must have direct experience with personal loans and unsecured financing options, including:



SoFi



LightStream



Upgrade



LendingClub



Discover Personal Loans or comparable lenders



Banks and credit unions



Personal lines of credit



Unsecured personal loans



Debt consolidation financing



Responsibilities include:



Understanding lender credit score, income, and debt-to-income requirements.



Identifying which lenders best match a client's qualifications.



Reviewing prequalification options when available.



Understanding soft inquiries versus hard inquiries.



Evaluating loan amounts, interest rates, repayment terms, and approval conditions.



Assisting clients throughout the application and documentation process.



3. Business Funding & Credit Card Stacking



Must have experience with:



Business credit cards



Business lines of credit



Business term loans



Business credit card stacking strategies



Business credit building



Revenue-based financing



SBA financing fundamentals



Unsecured business funding



Responsibilities include:



Evaluating business revenue, time in business, creditworthiness, and available documentation.



Identifying business financing options based on personal and business credit profiles.



Understanding personal guarantees and business credit requirements.



Developing responsible credit card stacking strategies where appropriate.



Understanding lender application rules and inquiry sensitivity.



Helping clients avoid unnecessary applications and excessive debt exposure.



Managing funding applications and tracking approvals.



4. HELOCs & Secured Financing



Must understand:



Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs)



Home equity loans



Loan-to-value (LTV) and combined loan-to-value (CLTV)



Equity calculations



Property-based financing



Income and credit qualification requirements



Owner-occupied versus investment property financing



Secured versus unsecured borrowing



The specialist must be able to identify when a client may benefit from an equity-based funding option compared with an unsecured personal or business loan.



5. Funding Strategy & Client Management



Conduct funding consultations and financial profile reviews.



Determine the most appropriate funding route for each client.



Explain funding options, qualifications, and potential limitations.



Create organized funding plans based on client goals.



Request and review required financial documents.



Track applications, pending approvals, denials, and completed funding.



Maintain accurate client records and provide consistent updates.



Follow up with clients and lenders throughout the process.



Coordinate with our credit repair team to identify clients who may qualify for funding after improving their credit profiles.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 2+ years of verifiable experience in personal funding, business funding, lending, or financing services.



Proven experience working with U.S. lenders and financial institutions.



Hands-on experience with personal loans, including SoFi or comparable lenders.



Strong knowledge of business lines of credit, business credit cards, and credit card stacking.



Understanding of HELOCs, home equity financing, and secured lending.



Ability to analyze consumer credit reports and financial documents.



Familiarity with Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports.



Strong understanding of FICO scores, utilization, debt-to-income ratios, and lender qualification requirements.



Experience managing funding applications from initial consultation through final decision.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



Experience with CRM systems and client tracking software.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience with a U.S.-based credit repair or funding company.



Experience working with multiple lenders and financing products.



Knowledge of business credit bureaus and business credit profiles.



Familiarity with GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.



Experience developing funding strategies for entrepreneurs, real estate investors, and small business owners.



Understanding of lender underwriting guidelines and documentation requirements.



Performance Expectations



The ideal candidate must be able to:



Review a client's credit and financial profile and determine funding readiness.



Identify suitable personal or business funding opportunities.



Explain why a client may or may not qualify for specific funding products.



Develop a clear funding strategy based on the client's financial goals.



Manage multiple funding applications and client files efficiently.



Maintain accurate records of submitted applications, approvals, denials, and funding amounts.



Communicate proactively with clients and management.



Recommend when a client should improve their credit profile before pursuing financing.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your updated resume.



A brief summary of your personal and business funding experience.



The lenders and funding products you have worked with directly.



Your experience with SoFi, HELOCs, business lines of credit, and credit card stacking.



Examples of funding cases you have successfully handled, without disclosing confidential client information.



Your expected monthly salary.



Your availability and preferred working hours.



Important: Applicants must have actual funding experience. General customer service, credit repair, or appointment-setting experience alone does not qualify.



We are looking for a knowledgeable, detail-oriented Funding Specialist who can independently evaluate client profiles, identify appropriate financing solutions, and help grow our funding department.

title: Creative Director
description:
About Us

We run a high-ticket Done-For-You Airbnb Arbitrage Program that helps entrepreneurs launch and scale profitable Airbnb businesses without the trial and error. We're growing fast and need someone sharp, creative, and hungry to join our team full-time.



The Role

We're looking for a hands-on creative producer who will own the volume and quality of everything that goes in front of our paid ad audience — image ads, video edits, and hook variations, tested at real scale.



This isn't a "make one nice ad a week" role. You'll be producing dozens of new creative variations weekly — new hooks, new edits, new angles on existing winners — so our media buyer always has fresh material to test. We're currently testing ~20 creatives a month and need to be testing hundreds.



I own the strategy — the angles, the offers, what themes to explore. You own turning that into a constant stream of scroll-stopping creative, fast. If you've run your own content or social agency before, this is that same production muscle, just pointed at performance instead of brand.



This is a long-term seat. The person who does this well ends up building and running the creative team under them.



Responsibilities

Produce a high volume of image and video ad creative weekly — hook swaps, new edits, resizing for placements, testing variations of proven winners.



Edit raw footage/photos into scroll-stopping short-form video ads (CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent).



Design static image ads in Canva or equivalent, on-brand and conversion-focused.



Turn rough ideas, Looms, and competitor references into finished creative fast — no hand-holding required.



Maintain a swipe file of competitor and top-performing ads from the Meta Ad Library for inspiration.



Keep the creative library organized and tagged so winners and their variants are easy to find and iterate on.



Work closely with our media buyer — take their read on what's working/dying and turn it into the next batch of creative to test.



Proactively pitch new angles and formats, not just execute what's asked.



Requirements

Real, demonstrable design and video editing chops — a portfolio of ads or social content you've actually made, not just directed.



Experience running or working inside a social media / content agency is a big plus — we specifically want people who know how to produce at volume, not just produce one polished piece at a time.



Comfortable with Canva, CapCut, Premiere (or equivalent) and moving fast between them.



Understands what makes a paid social ad stop the scroll — hook-first thinking, not brand-deck thinking.



Extremely self-sufficient with a "figure it out" attitude. I don't have time to unblock you daily.



Obsessive attention to detail — off-brand or sloppy creative going live is unacceptable.



Full-time availability, 40 hours per week, 10 AM – 6 PM ET.



Compensation

$4,000/month to start.



Performance bonus up to $1,000/month tied to creative testing volume and quality, to be discussed after 90 days in the role.



Long-term role with real growth as we scale and build out a creative team.

description:

About Service Conversion



Service Conversion helps businesses grow through digital marketing, lead generation, automation, analytics, and technology. We are looking for a technically capable and detail-oriented specialist to manage website tracking, analytics implementations, and internal business applications.



 Job Overview



We are looking for someone with practical experience in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Google AppSheet.



This role combines analytics and tracking implementation with the development and maintenance of internal tools. You will help ensure that website activity, conversions, and marketing performance are tracked accurately while building applications that improve our team's workflows and operational efficiency.



The ideal candidate can troubleshoot technical issues, work with Google Sheets and data structures, implement tracking solutions, and turn business requirements into reliable, practical systems.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, document their work, and take ownership of assigned projects.



Key Responsibilities



Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Configure and validate events, key events, and conversion tracking.

- Analyze website traffic, user behavior, traffic sources, and conversion performance.

- Investigate tracking discrepancies and data accuracy issues.

- Build and maintain reports and explorations to measure website and marketing performance.

- Work with Google Ads and other marketing platforms to support accurate conversion measurement.

- Maintain clear documentation of tracking configurations and changes.



Google Tag Manager (GTM)

- Troubleshoot duplicate events, missing conversions, incorrect triggers, and other tracking issues.

- Coordinate with website developers when changes to website code or data layers are required.

- Follow appropriate consent and privacy requirements when implementing tracking.



Google AppSheet



- Build, maintain, and improve business applications using Google AppSheet.

- Convert existing Google Sheets into structured, functional applications.

- Design data tables, columns, references, forms, views, dashboards, and workflows.

- Configure AppSheet automation, actions, and notifications.

Google Sheets and Data Management

title: Head of Marketing — Paid Media, Retention & Ecommerce
description:
A profitable, growing US-based specialty tea CPG brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders, warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU) selling primarily through Shopify and TikTok Shop, built on authentic sourcing, education, and a founder-creator with millions of followers who is, today, the company's entire marketing engine. The brand ships frequent new product lines (two launches in the next four months alone) and runs a quarterly subscription program (~2,000 members) that is the growth core. The founder built the entire business on organic content and the company has never run paid ads. Marketing today is a set of good ideas with no owner:
, loyalty, referrals, collabs, community, contests. Your job is to become that owner, and to build the machine around the founder's audience instead of depending on it.

One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. All creative is real and hand-made. That is the brand's identity, not a policy. See "How this company uses AI" below; it will d
 whether this role is for you.



The role

You own marketing end to end. This is a content-led brand: high-quality entertainment and infotainment IS the acquisition engine, and everything you do in paid,
, and lifecycle has to interact coherently with the organic machine, not run beside it. You understand how paid and organic feed each other and you manage brand awareness as one system.

The mandate runs in a deliberate order. First, find the leaks and build the scoreboard: subscription drop-off, paused members, one-time buyers, and the KPI system to see it all. Second, stand up paid media and get the
 and lifecycle machine performing. Third, once the fundamentals run, expand into organic collaboration: creator collabs, bigger content plays, deeper integration with the founder's production. The wrong hire walks in asking for a big ad budget. The right hire walks in asking where the money is leaking and what the data says.

You are a player-coach, weighted toward player early. You personally run media strategy and media buying (today's AI-powered buying tools make this a one-person job at this scale) until the marketing arm grows enough to justify dedicated hands, at which point you help define that hire. The
 specialist reports to you and executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction. You'll also coordinate with the rest of the small team around marketing: a Shopify/ecommerce operations person and the founder's YouTube account manager.

On creative: you are close to a creative director who never creates. The founder is the creator. He likes performing, he WANTS to make ads, and he already has some in production. Your job is to make that enthusiasm strategic and intentional: understand the brand's edges and preferences deeply enough to direct
, paid media, and collab work cohesively without ever violating the ethos, and to tell him exactly what the data says he should make next. He will make you one great ad at a time, not fifteen mediocre ones.

This is not a strategy-deck job. You make tactical judgment calls on messaging, audiences, offers, and budget the same day they come up, and you push initiatives to done. The unofficial title is "the person who makes marketing ideas stop dying in the parking lot."



What you'll do

Find the leaks and build the scoreboard

Diagnose subscription drop-off: who leaves, when (the drop after box two and three is the known weak point), and why

Quantify how much meat is on the bone: lapsed members, paused subscriptions, one-time buyers who never subscribed,
 list segments that never converted



Think in the levers that multiply the business: LTV, AOV, CAC, churn, and net-new customers. When the data to see a lever doesn't exist, you fix the measurement system so it does

Run the win-back loop for paused and lapsed members, working with the internal AI survey systems that surface why people pause



Run paid media yourself

Launch paid ads from zero (Meta first, TikTok second) with an intro test budget, personally owning media strategy and buying with modern AI-powered tools



Approach ads from first principles: early paid is a learning instrument. Breaking even early on is a perfectly good outcome; the bar is don't bleed money while collecting the data that verifies hunches and shapes the growth plan, then refine and iterate from there



Run the full range deliberately: put cash behind organic content that's already working, test odd angles, and run boring direct-response ads. You have to be comfortable with both the weird and the boring

Build the creative testing plan around the founder's content and the ads he has in production; brief him on what to make next based on what the data says



Own holiday-season ad buying (Oct through Feb is the season)

Earn the budget: scale spend only as unit economics prove out, and be the person telling the founder when NOT to spend



Own
, lifecycle, and loyalty

Set strategy for and manage the
 specialist, who executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction

Evolve loyalty into a VIP program and fold the referral program into its tiers

Multiply LTV and AOV: bundles, premium tiers, subscription upgrades, win-backs

Expand the organic machine (stage two, after the fundamentals run)



Lead creator collab strategy, including YouTube collaborations: you set the strategy and direct it, with outreach and legwork resources added as the workload materializes

Surface-manage the content production workflow (the founder has a YouTube account manager) enough to keep it moving and connected to the rest of marketing

Deepen the paid-organic loop as both sides mature



Run the machine

Build the marketing calendar and own cross-channel coordination across Shopify and TikTok Shop: a constant new-product launch cadence (next two launches already scheduled for mid-September and November) and the holiday season

Direct the founder's creative production: batched, specific asks with clear briefs, on his rhythm

Run the AI marketing stack for analytics and orchestration, and teach: make sure the whole team understands what the numbers say and why



Be our eyes and ears on the marketing org: as channels prove out, you define the next roles the team needs and help us scope them



Who survives here

The founder runs this company as a creator and an artist. He will not work 70-hour weeks, he will not sit in frequent syncs, and he does not want to be managed hard. There are standing weekly team calls and brand-alignment checks; beyond that, you get batched, well-prepared asks and a lot of autonomy.

The person who thrives: a first-principles thinker who asks "what are the alternatives" and comes at problems from angles, cares deeply about brand ethos and being genuine, and is flexible and adaptable when the picture changes. Low ego, systems-builder, gets energy from ownership rather than access, treats the founder as a scarce production resource and designs the work around that constraint. A sense of humor is close to required: the brand runs on it. The person who fails: needs frequent alignment meetings, wants to "workshop the vision" repeatedly, bulldozes the founder's constraints in the name of growth, or is too proud to run boring ads.



How this company uses AI

The company runs a deliberate split: aggressive AI adoption in operations, a hard wall around anything creative or customer-facing. This role sits exactly on that line and has to hold it.



The wall (creative side)

- Nothing customer-facing is AI-generated. No AI images ever, no AI-written copy shipped as-is. This is brand identity, not a preference: the entire premise of the brand is that everything is real. Real sourcing trips, real photos, real people.

- The standard is cultural, not just a rule. Real example: product photos came back with dust on them right before a launch, the founder was unreachable, and the team spent hours manually retouching the dust out rather than AI-recreating the images, because they knew that is what he would want. That instinct is the hiring bar.

- AI-assisted drafting is tolerated only when the shipped output is written by hand or aggressively reviewed by hand. AI passing as human is the sin. A previous team member put an obviously AI-generated image into an internal test
; it never shipped and it was still treated as a serious culture violation.



The embrace (operations side)

- The company builds internal AI agents aggressively: live inventory and logistics answers for the CS team, a demand-prediction model for new products, and a customer survey loop that maps the customer journey.

- The founder's stated goal is a middle road: full transparency with the team about how AI is used, so nobody feels they are training their replacement, and AI kept as far from the creative side as possible.



What this means for you

- You manage the AI marketing setup: agent-driven ad analytics and orchestration (think "this ad is overperforming in one region, redivert budget"), AI-powered media buying, research, segmentation, reporting, workflow. Analytics and orchestration, yes. Generating ads, images, or copy that ships, no.

- You are also the translator: part of the job is making sure everyone on the team understands what the AI spend analytics say and why, in plain language.

- The founder believes AI slop is destroying trust in faceless content and low-tier influencer marketing, and that this brand's realness becomes MORE valuable as that happens. He has watched an agency lose his business by sending an unchecked AI-generated proposal. Pitching AI-generated creator content or mass AI outreach in your interview ends the interview.





What you've done before

- 6+ years across multiple marketing channels with your own hands: paid social,
/retention, loyalty or referral programs, influencer or community marketing

- Hands-on media strategy and media buying: you have personally planned, bought, and optimized paid media, not just supervised an agency doing it

- Food and beverage CPG experience is required: you have marketed a consumable product people buy repeatedly, and you understand replenishment cycles, taste-driven loyalty, and launch cadence

- Subscription experience is required: you have managed a subscription service and its retention economics, not just one-time - - DTC

- DTC ecommerce experience; Shopify fluency expected, TikTok Shop experience a strong plus

- Startup or small-team environments: you have been the whole marketing department before, comfortable with scrappiness and wearing every hat, not corporate structure and big budgets

- You understand content-led brands: experience running or working inside media/content production is a real asset, because here the content IS the marketing

- Ran frequent product launches end to end as the project manager, not just the channel owner; this brand ships new lines constantly and the calendar never stops

- Managed at least a small team or agency relationships; comfortable being the strategy layer for an executor

- Worked directly with a founder or creative director and can tell us how you adapted to them

- Comfortable managing AI agents and tools in your workflow; clear-eyed about where AI belongs and where it does not

- You should genuinely enjoy the product. Tea, tea culture, or Chinese culture as a real personal interest is close to a requirement here: this team lives the product, and it shows in the work. Comedic sensibility is a plus, since the founder's content runs on humor

title: AI Direct Response Video Editor (Meta Ads)
description:

We’re specifically looking for an editor who combines great direct response editing with advanced AI content creation. If you can generate realistic AI UGC, create attention-grabbing AI animations, and turn completely new ideas into Meta ads that convert — this is for you.



Who are we?

We’re a young, ambitious e-commerce company selling premium cleaning products in the US through our brand Shiny Wipes. In the last two years, we’ve managed to hit multiple 7 figures in yearly revenue and aim to hit 8 figures within the next 12 months.

Our small but dynamic team is hungry for success, and we value continuous improvement, accountability, and respect in everything we do. If you're looking for more than a typical 9-5 job, eager to take on challenges, and ready to play a key role in our growth, you’ll fit right in.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less — and quickly.

We use data to make decisions and live by the following core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday".

We love learning — every problem is an opportunity to grow.

This is not a chill corporate editing job. This is for people who are obsessed with performance creatives, actively experiment with new AI tools, and want to stay at the forefront of where advertising is going.



What You’ll Be Doing

Edit high-converting direct response video ads for Meta.

Generate realistic AI UGC, including AI characters, environments, voiceovers, and scenes that feel native to social media.

Create completely new AI-powered ad concepts — from Pixar-style animation and claymation to CGI, product animations, and other scroll-stopping formats.

Combine AI-generated content, real UGC, product footage, stock footage, graphics, and sound into polished performance ads.

Create variations of winning creatives, hooks, concepts, and angles together with our creative strategist.

Continuously test new AI tools and workflows to create better content faster.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable):

Strong experience editing direct response ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).

Excellent understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, psychology, storytelling, and conversion-focused editing.

Strong hands-on experience with AI video and image generation. You should already be actively using multiple AI tools — not just experimenting with them occasionally.

Adobe Premiere Pro (must-have, daily tool).

Fluent in English (written & spoken).

40 hours/week availability (full-time, long-term).

Salary Expectation

Base salary of $1,500 USD per month.



How To Apply

When you apply, you must start your application with the code word: SHINY

If you want to be part of a fast-growing brand, experiment with the newest creative technology, work with people who care deeply about performance, and create ads that most editors simply aren't capable of producing yet — we’d love to hear from you.

## About Willow Park Health



Willow Park Health is a growing healthcare organization based in New York, providing onsite psychiatric care and therapy to seniors in assisted living and other senior living communities.



Our mission is to help seniors age with grace, dignity, and purpose. We work closely with clinicians, community wellness teams, residents, and families to make behavioral healthcare accessible and well coordinated.

This is a hands-on administrative and care coordination role requiring regular phone calls, clear written communication, accurate documentation, and proactive follow-through. Your nursing background will help you understand medical terminology, recognize issues requiring escalation, and communicate effectively with healthcare teams.



Clinical decisions and treatment remain the responsibility of the treating providers.



## Key Responsibilities



### Patient Intake & Records



- Coordinate new referrals and collect facesheets, medication lists, signed consent forms, and other required documents.

- Register patients in SimplePractice and maintain accurate demographic and administrative information.

- Identify missing or inconsistent information and follow up with facility staff or families before appointments.

- Keep records organized and document coordination activities in approved systems.



### Provider Scheduling & Visit Preparation



- Manage assigned provider calendars across multiple senior living communities.

- Coordinate new evaluations, follow-up appointments, cancellations, and rescheduling.

- Prepare and confirm schedules in advance, ensuring providers have the information needed for their visits.

- Work with facility staff to identify residents due for follow-up and maintain backup lists when appointments change.

- Track missed or refused visits and coordinate next steps.

- Schedule future appointments according to provider instructions.



### Facility, Patient & Family Communication



- Build professional relationships with community wellness teams, providers, residents, and families.

- Respond to calls,
s, texts, and faxes through approved practice systems during scheduled working hours.

- Provide clear updates about appointments, paperwork, and outstanding requests.

- Promptly route clinical questions, medication concerns, refill requests, and urgent messages to the appropriate clinician using established procedures.

- Track requests through resolution and confirm that relevant parties receive updates.



### Daily Practice Operations



- Maintain scheduling trackers, task lists, spreadsheets, and shared operational documents.

- Review visit completion and flag missing administrative information or documentation for the appropriate team member.

- Coordinate with billing and credentialing staff when records or information are needed.

- Provide concise daily updates covering completed work, unresolved issues, and items requiring management attention.

- Support administrative projects and help document repeatable workflows.



### Quality & Process Improvement



- Check patient and scheduling information for accuracy and resolve administrative discrepancies.

- Identify recurring scheduling gaps, communication delays, and workflow problems.

- Recommend practical improvements and help implement approved changes.

- Protect patient confidentiality and follow practice privacy, security, and HIPAA procedures.



## What Success Looks Like



- Providers receive accurate schedules and required records before visits.

- New referrals move through intake without avoidable delays.

- Follow-up appointments and outstanding requests are actively tracked.

- Facility staff and families receive timely, professional communication.

- Management has a clear view of open issues and next steps.

- Tasks are completed accurately with minimal reminders.



## Required Qualifications



- **Registered Nurse (RN) with an active Philippine nursing license.**

- Previous experience in healthcare administration, patient care coordination, medical scheduling, or virtual medical assistance.

- Excellent spoken and written English, including confidence communicating by phone with U.S. healthcare professionals and families.

- Strong understanding of medical terminology and ability to recognize concerns requiring clinician review.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to prioritize competing requests and manage multiple provider schedules.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, calendars, and digital records.

- Sound judgment about when to resolve administrative issues independently and when to escalate them.

- Availability to work agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours, including seasonal daylight saving time changes.

- Reliable computer, stable internet, quality headset, and a quiet, private workspace.

- A practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience supporting a U.S. medical or behavioral health practice.

- Familiarity with SimplePractice, PointClickCare, or similar EMR systems.

- Experience in psychiatry, geriatrics, or senior living.

- Experience creating SOPs, maintaining operational trackers, or improving administrative workflows.



## Tools & Systems



You may work with SimplePractice, PointClickCare, Google Workspace, Microsoft Outlook, phone and fax platforms, and internal scheduling trackers.



Training will be provided on practice-specific workflows. AI tools may be used only as approved by the practice and in accordance with patient privacy requirements.



## Why Join Willow Park Health?



- Long-term remote opportunity with a growing healthcare organization.

- Meaningful work supporting seniors and their families.

- A supportive team that values reliability, initiative, and clear communication.

- Opportunity to take on greater responsibility as your skills and the practice grow.



## How to Apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line:



**RN Patient Care Coordinator – [Your Full Name]**



Include:



1. Your updated résumé and confirmation of your active Philippine RN license.

2. A brief summary of your relevant experience, including whether you have supported a U.S. healthcare practice.

3. A one- to two-minute voice or video introduction explaining your experience and interest in the role.

4. The EMR, scheduling, and communication tools you have used.

5. Your availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours, earliest start date, and expected hourly rate.

6. A brief response to this scenario:



**A provider is visiting a community tomorrow. Three residents are missing consent forms, two medication lists are outdated, and the wellness director has not confirmed the schedule. What would you do, and how would you keep everyone informed?**



Please use hypothetical examples only and do not include patient information from previous employers.

title: Purchase Order & Procurement Specialist
description:
Job Title: Senior Purchasing & Order Fulfillment Specialist (3–5+ Years Experience Required)



Company: STX Promo



Compensation: $8.50 USD / hour



Schedule: Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST



Location: Remote (Offshore Independent Contractor)





⚠️ STRICT APPLICATION REQUIREMENT⚠️ 



This position requires a minimum of 3 to 5 years of direct Purchasing, Buying, or Procurement experience. Candidates without verified past purchasing experience will be automatically filtered out and will not be considered.





Company Overview:



STX Promo is a high-growth promotional products company on a massive upward trajectory—our business is up 750% year-over-year, and we are scaling rapidly by adding 1–2 new team members every single month. We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative, and highly organized environment. If you want to leverage your deep purchasing background alongside a dynamic team that values efficiency, team support, and rewarding top performers, STX Promo is the place for you.





Role Overview:



We are seeking an experienced, detail-obsessed, and articulate Purchasing & Order Fulfillment Specialist with a proven track record in vendor procurement and order management. You will serve as the operational backbone of our fulfillment process—placing purchase orders, auditing complex artwork proofs, tracking shipments, and resolving vendor discrepancies. You will work closely with our Sales & Production Coordinators and Director of Operations in a supportive team setting.





Key Responsibilities:



Purchase Order Processing: Accurately submit, manage, and audit purchase orders (POs) across various vendor portals, websites, and
 channels.



Proof Audit & Verification: Inspect vendor artwork proofs to ensure they match approved client mockups, product colors, dimensions, and imprint locations before approving production.



Shopify Fulfillment & Tracking: Update order records in the Shopify backend, attach tracking details, and monitor vendor production timelines against customer deadlines.



Vendor Phone Calls & Claims: Place phone calls to vendors to negotiate order details, track down urgent shipments, or manage complex cases regarding vendor errors, misprints, damages, or credits.



Cross-Functional Operations: Collaborate verbally and via text with our U.S.-based team and internal Coordinators on ClickUp, stepping in to assist with administrative tasks during lighter order windows.





Qualifications & Requirements (Mandatory):



Mandatory Experience: 3–5+ years of verified past experience as a Purchaser, Buyer, Procurement Specialist, or Purchase Order Coordinator.



English Fluency: Exceptional written and spoken English. You must be confident and clear on phone calls with U.S. vendors and during team check-ins.



Software Experience: Proficiency with ClickUp, Shopify backend, Google Workspace, and web-based vendor platforms.



Uncompromising Detail: Exceptional ability to audit artwork proofs, numbers, addresses, product SKUs, and purchase orders without missing a single detail.



Work Setup: High-speed, reliable internet, a quiet working environment, and a clear headset/microphone for phone calls (U.S. phone line software provided by STX Promo).



Schedule & Availability: Dedicated commitment to work 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday.



Industry Experience: Background in the promotional products industry is a strong plus.





Benefits & Compensation Package:



Competitive Base: Starting rate of $8.50 USD/hour 



13th-Month Pay: Guaranteed annual 13th-month bonus paid around the holidays.



Paid Time Off: Paid Vacation Days (PTO) and Paid Sick Days starting from Year 1, scaling upward with tenure.



Paid U.S. Holidays: Full pay on major U.S. recognized holidays.



Performance Bonuses: Monthly company growth bonuses during high-volume months.





How to Apply:



To apply, you must meet the minimum 3-year purchasing requirement and reply with:



Your updated resume (clearly highlighting your 3–5+ years of purchasing/buying experience).



Include the exact phrase "Experienced Purchasing Specialist" in your application subject line or opening message.



Applications without a verified purchasing background, a voice/video recording, or the required subject line will be immediately declined.





If we like your resume the second step will be to send a short (1–2 minute) video or voice recording link (via Loom, Vocaroo, or Google Drive) introducing yourself, detailing your specific purchasing experience, and explaining why you want to join STX Promo.

title: Remote Accounts Receivable
description:
# Accounts Receivable Specialist (m/f/d) – Remote



**Department:** Finance & Accounting  

**Location:** Remote  

**Employment Type:** Full-time  

**Company:** IronMaxx Nutrition GmbH



## About IronMaxx



IronMaxx is a fast-growing European sports nutrition brand, developing and distributing innovative products across e-commerce, retail, marketplaces, and international markets.



As our business continues to expand, we are strengthening our Finance & Accounting team and looking for a reliable, detail-oriented **Accounts Receivable Specialist** to support our daily financial operations remotely.



## Your Responsibilities



**Accounts Receivable & Payment Management**

- Manage day-to-day accounts receivable activities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of customer payments.

- Monitor outstanding receivables, track overdue invoices, and follow up on payment discrepancies.

- Reconcile incoming payments with open customer invoices and accounts.

- Maintain accurate customer account balances and resolve inconsistencies.



**Collections & Claims Management**

- Support the dunning and collections process, including payment reminders and overdue account follow-ups.

- Investigate payment differences, deductions, credit notes, and disputed invoices.

- Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, and Finance to resolve outstanding claims.

- Maintain transparent documentation of open receivables and their resolution status.



**Accounting & Reporting**

- Record and reconcile accounts receivable transactions in our ERP system (SAP Business One).

- Assist with month-end closing activities and accounts receivable reconciliations.

- Prepare aging reports, outstanding balance overviews, and other financial analyses.

- Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and automation within AR processes.



## Your Profile



- Completed education or degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

- At least 2–3 years of professional experience in Accounts Receivable, Finance Operations, or General Accounting.

- Strong understanding of invoice processing, payment reconciliation, collections, and customer account management.

- Experience working with ERP/accounting systems; **SAP Business One is a strong advantage**.

- Excellent Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.

- Proactive approach to identifying and resolving financial discrepancies.

- Comfortable working independently and communicating effectively in a remote environment.

- **Good English communication skills; German is a strong advantage**, particularly for DACH customer correspondence.



## What We Offer



- Remote working arrangement with an international, collaborative team.

- Opportunity to contribute to a growing European consumer brand.

- Exposure to multiple sales channels, including B2B, retail, e-commerce, and marketplaces.

- A dynamic environment with ownership of operational accounting activities.

- Opportunities to improve processes, implement automation, and grow professionally.

- Structured onboarding and close collaboration with our Finance team in Germany.



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will:



- Take ownership of assigned customer accounts and daily AR activities.

- Ensure consistent monitoring and accurate reconciliation of incoming payments.

- Establish clear visibility of overdue balances and unresolved payment discrepancies.

- Support timely month-end closing and reliable AR reporting.

- Identify at least one opportunity to improve an existing accounts receivable process.



**Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?**



Join IronMaxx and help us build scalable, reliable financial processes that support our international growth.

title: Customer Support Agent – Remote | $10/Hour
description:
# Customer Support Agent – Remote | $10/Hour



We are an international online trading education academy looking to hire **10 professional Customer Support Agents** to join our growing team.



We are looking for reliable, friendly, and highly motivated individuals with excellent English communication skills.



This is a remote customer support position focused on two main responsibilities: **Welcome Calls and WhatsApp Student Support.**



This is NOT a sales position or a trading coaching position.



### 1. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



**Welcome Calls – Phone Support**



- Contact newly enrolled students within 3 minutes of receiving an enrollment notification.

- Welcome students to our academy in a friendly and professional manner.

- Explain their next steps and help them book their onboarding session.

- Answer basic questions and ensure students feel comfortable and supported.



**WhatsApp Lifeline – Student Support**



- Monitor our student WhatsApp support groups during your assigned shift.

- Respond to technical and administrative questions.

- Assist students with platform access, curriculum navigation, scheduling, and general inquiries.

- Escalate questions or problems that require assistance from another department.



Our Lifeline is a support channel, not a trading coaching service.



### 2. WORKING HOURS & FLEXIBILITY



- $10 USD per hour.

- 4-hour paid shifts.

- 100% remote position.

- Work directly from your smartphone.

- Assigned shifts based on our international support schedule.

- Opportunities for long-term employment.



**You are paid for your availability, not for the number of calls or messages you receive.**



Some days you may receive only a few support messages or no phone calls. Other days may be busier.



Regardless of workload, you will be paid for your entire scheduled shift.



However, you must remain available, attentive, and responsive throughout all 4 hours.



You do not need to sit in front of a computer, but you must have your phone ready and be able to take professional calls in a quiet environment whenever needed.



### 3. REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Clear, friendly, and confident telephone communication.

- Previous customer support experience is preferred.

- Reliable smartphone and internet connection.

- Ability to follow instructions and procedures.

- Professional attitude and strong communication skills.

- Responsible, punctual, and dependable.

- Ability to remain available throughout assigned shifts.



### 4. IMPORTANT – MANDATORY SOP REVIEW



**PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.**



We take customer support quality extremely seriously.



We have prepared a short Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) explaining the responsibilities and communication standards expected from our Customer Support Agents.



**READ OUR SOP HERE: [INSERT GOOGLE DOCS LINK]**



You MUST read and understand this document before submitting your application.



### 5. PRACTICAL PHONE ASSESSMENT



Selected applicants will participate in a practical phone assessment.



One of our coaches will call you and act as a newly enrolled student.



You will be expected to handle the conversation professionally, following the instructions described in the SOP.



We will evaluate:



- Your spoken English.

- Your confidence and professionalism.

- Your understanding of the SOP.

- Your ability to welcome and guide a new student.

- Your communication and problem-solving skills.



You do not need to memorize a script. We want to see how naturally and professionally you communicate.



### 6. HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, your application MUST include:



1. **Introduction:** A short introduction about yourself and your previous customer support experience.

2. **Voice Recording:** A 60–90 second recording introducing yourself in English.

3. **Availability:** Your time zone and preferred working hours.

4. **SOP Confirmation:** Confirm that you have read and understood our complete Candidate SOP.

5. **Practical Question:** Explain briefly what you would do if you received a notification that a new student had just enrolled.



**IMPORTANT: Applications that do not include all five requirements will not be considered.**



We are not interested in receiving hundreds of generic applications.



We are looking for professional, committed individuals who take customer service seriously and are willing to follow our procedures.



**If you have not read the SOP, please DO NOT apply.**



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper (Remote – Los Angeles-Based Construction Company) 

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, trustworthy, and highly experienced Bookkeeper with extensive QuickBooks experience to manage the day-to-day financial transactions and accounting records of a construction company based in Los Angeles, California.



This position will start as a part-time remote role, working 3 hours per day from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM Pacific Time, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position as the company’s needs grow.



We’re looking for someone dependable, organized, and capable of maintaining accurate financial records while supporting the company’s ongoing financial operations.



Responsibilities 

• Record, categorize, and track daily financial transactions, including expenses, income, vendor payments, and customer payments.

• Manage and maintain the company’s financial records using QuickBooks.

• Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements regularly.

• Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

• Track vendor invoices, bills, payments, and outstanding balances.

• Prepare financial summaries, expense reports, and monthly financial statements.

• Maintain organized, accurate, and up-to-date accounting records.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial transactions and account balances.

• Assist with other bookkeeping and accounting tasks as needed.



Requirements 

• At least 2 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience, preferably with a construction company or a similar business.

• Extensive hands-on experience using QuickBooks is required. Applicants must be highly proficient in managing transactions, reconciling accounts, handling accounts payable and receivable, and generating financial reports.

• Strong understanding of bookkeeping principles and general accounting practices.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) 

• Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace 

• Must be available to work consistently from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM Pacific Time (Los Angeles time).

• Willingness and availability to transition from part-time to full-time employment as the position develops.



What We Offer

We’re looking for an Administrative Agent to help support our sales and recruiting teams. This is an entry-level position that is eligible for promotion after 12 months of tenure.

About Us



Started in 2017, and we're growing like crazy.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2025, and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2026.

Health Insurance





Entry Level Details

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Customer Service, VA Admin, Admin Data Processing, Clerk,
 Communications, General VA, Admin Support, Sales and Admin Specialist, Administrative Support, Operations Admin, Executive Admin Assistant, Sales Assistant.





Duties and Responsibilities

Instructor Onboarding, Offboarding and Reonboarding

Reactivate Unavailable Instructor

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Duplicate Record Check

Updating the "Daily Tracking" Process

CTM Prospect Staging





Qualifications

At least 2-3 years of minimum work experience in a relevant or equivalent role

Comprehensive background in Customer and Administrative support

High level of accuracy and attention to detail

Excellent English communication and comprehension

Proficiency in using and managing Google applications - Gmail, Calendar, Documents, Drive

Preferably with knowledge in using cloud-based CRM

Organized and has careful attention to detail

Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and the ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Equipped with good skills in office/admin management, and can suggest process improvements

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and a good quality headset and microphone.





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.
