title: Full-Time General Manager / Head of Operations
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:



A growing Europe - based financial firm is looking for a highly experienced full-time General Manager / Head of Operations to work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business.



This is a SENIOR MANAGEMENT POSITION.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant role.

This is NOT an Executive Assistant role.

This is NOT an entry-level management position.



We are looking for someone who has already managed employees, business operations, KPIs, sales performance, processes and daily company activity.



The successful candidate will be responsible for making sure the company operates properly every day without the CEO needing to personally manage each employee or chase routine tasks.



You must be confident making decisions, managing staff, solving problems, implementing systems, monitoring performance and holding employees accountable.



The CEO will remain responsible for overall strategy and major business decisions.



YOU will be responsible for making sure the business runs.





WORKING HOURS:



Monday to Friday



9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK TIME



40 HOURS PER WEEK



FULL-TIME ONLY



You must be available and responsive throughout working hours.



You must be able to START WITHIN THE NEXT 7 DAYS.





MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:





DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS:



- Take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the company

- Ensure all departments and employees are completing their responsibilities

- Organise daily and weekly priorities

- Identify operational problems and resolve them quickly

- Build and improve company processes

- Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Ensure deadlines are met

- Make routine operational decisions without constantly escalating matters to the CEO

- Ensure the company remains organised and productive





STAFF MANAGEMENT:



- Directly manage company employees

- Assign responsibilities and priorities

- Monitor employee performance

- Follow up incomplete work

- Hold staff accountable for agreed targets

- Conduct regular staff meetings

- Manage attendance, productivity and performance issues

- Support recruitment and staff onboarding

- Assist with disciplinary and performance-management processes when required

- Identify when additional staff are needed

- Ensure employees understand their responsibilities

- Create a professional and accountable working environment





KPI & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT:



- Create clear KPIs for each employee

- Monitor daily, weekly and monthly performance

- Identify underperformance quickly

- Implement improvement plans

- Review staff productivity

- Produce management reports

- Ensure targets are measurable

- Ensure employees are producing results rather than simply appearing busy





SALES OPERATIONS:



- Oversee the B2B sales function

- Monitor sales activity and sales KPIs

- Review CRM activity

- Monitor lead follow-ups

- Ensure sales opportunities are not being ignored

- Review pipeline performance

- Track meetings, opportunities, conversions and signed clients

- Hold the sales team accountable for results

- Identify problems affecting sales performance

- Work with the sales employee to improve conversion and follow-up processes





LEAD GENERATION OVERSIGHT:



- Manage the lead-generation/research employee

- Ensure lead information is accurate

- Monitor the number and quality of leads being produced

- Ensure company and decision-maker information is properly researched

- Prevent poor-quality, duplicate or fabricated data from entering the CRM

- Ensure the sales employee always has sufficient quality prospects to contact





CRM MANAGEMENT:



- Ensure CRM records are accurate and up to date

- Monitor lead and client stages

- Check employee CRM activity

- Ensure calls,
s, follow-ups and next actions are recorded

- Ensure no important opportunity is forgotten

- Maintain consistent CRM standards across the company





CLIENT & CASE OPERATIONS:



- Oversee new-client onboarding

- Ensure client information and documents are properly recorded

- Monitor active client matters

- Ensure client communications are professional and timely

- Oversee operational handover from sales to service delivery

- Monitor case progress once collection activity begins

- Ensure important client issues are escalated appropriately





FINANCIAL & BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION:



- Monitor operational expenses and subscriptions

- Review basic company financial information and reports

- Work with bookkeeping/accounting support where required

- Monitor invoices and company payment administration

- Help maintain accurate financial and operational records

- Identify unnecessary operational costs

- Provide the CEO with clear summaries of company performance





CEO REPORTING:



You will report directly to the CEO.



The CEO should NOT need to spend every day asking:



- What is each employee doing?

- Has this task been completed?

- Why was this client not followed up?

- Why has the CRM not been updated?

- Why are sales targets being missed?

- Who is responsible for this problem?



You will be expected to know the answers.



You will provide a clear weekly management report covering:



- Sales performance

- Lead generation

- Staff performance

- Client activity

- Operational problems

- KPIs

- Outstanding priorities

- Decisions requiring CEO approval





REQUIREMENTS:



YOU MUST HAVE:



- MINIMUM 5 YEARS’ PROVEN SENIOR MANAGEMENT / OPERATIONS EXPERIENCE

- Previous experience as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Head of Operations, COO, Business Manager or directly comparable senior role

- A Bachelor’s Degree or higher

- Proven experience managing multiple employees

- Proven experience managing KPIs

- Proven experience holding staff accountable for performance

- Experience managing day-to-day business operations

- Experience creating and improving SOPs and company processes

- Experience with CRM systems

- Experience overseeing sales or business-development employees

- Experience preparing management reports

- Strong understanding of business operations

- Strong problem-solving ability

- Excellent written English

- Excellent spoken English

- Strong leadership skills

- Strong professional judgement

- Excellent organisation

- Ability to work independently

- Ability to make decisions without constant supervision

- Ability to manage several departments and priorities simultaneously

- High level of confidentiality

- Verifiable previous employment history

- Professional references





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:



Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:



- Financial services

- B2B services

- Credit control

- Commercial collections

- Accounts receivable

- Business development

- Sales operations

- Construction-related businesses

- Professional services

- Remote team management

- UK companies or UK clients





MUST-HAVE SKILLS:



- Operations Management

- Staff Management

- KPI Management

- Business Management

- Leadership

- CRM Management

- Sales Oversight

- Process Improvement

- SOP Creation

- Performance Management

- Problem Solving

- Recruitment

- Reporting

- Business Administration





PERSONALITY FIT:



We are looking for someone who is:



- Highly responsible

- Commercially minded

- Organised

- Professional

- Confident

- Calm under pressure

- Proactive

- Decisive

- Reliable

- Honest

- Accountable

- Strong with people

- Comfortable challenging poor performance

- Able to solve problems independently

- Able to take ownership

- Able to manage employees without constant CEO involvement





THIS ROLE IS NOT SUITABLE FOR SOMEONE WHO:



- Has never managed employees

- Has less than 5 years relevant management experience

- Has only worked as a Virtual Assistant

- Has only worked as an Executive Assistant

- Has never been responsible for KPIs

- Avoids difficult conversations with staff

- Cannot make decisions independently

- Needs constant instructions from the CEO

- Cannot manage multiple departments

- Has no experience improving business processes

- Is looking for their first management opportunity





IMPORTANT:



THIS IS A SENIOR MANAGEMENT POSITION.



We are NOT looking for someone to learn how to become a manager.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to RUN DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS.



You will receive training on our company, services, systems and processes.



We will NOT train you in basic management, leadership or operations.



Previous employment, job titles, responsibilities, degree and references may be verified.



Please do not apply with false, exaggerated or unverifiable experience.



False or materially misleading information may result in your application being rejected and may be reported to OnlineJobs.ph where appropriate.





=================================================================================================



HOW TO APPLY:



⚠️ MINIMUM 40 APPLY POINTS REQUIRED



⚠️ APPLICATION CODE REQUIRED:



COO40-UKOPS26



You must place the following code at the VERY TOP of your application:



COO40-UKOPS26



Applications with fewer than 40 Apply Points will NOT be considered.



Applications without the correct application code will NOT be considered.



=================================================================================================



PLEASE ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS:





QUESTION 1:



How many years have you worked in senior operations or management positions?





QUESTION 2:



What is your CURRENT job position?



By CURRENT, we mean the position you are working in RIGHT NOW today.



Please include:

- Job title

- Industry

- Date started

- Full-time / part-time / freelance

- Working days and hours





QUESTION 3:



What was the highest-level management position you have held, and how long were you in that position?





QUESTION 4:



How many employees did you personally manage in your most recent management role?





QUESTION 5:



What KPIs were you personally responsible for monitoring?





QUESTION 6:



Give one specific example of an underperforming employee you managed.



Explain:

- What the problem was

- What YOU did

- What the final result was





QUESTION 7:



Give one specific example of a business process or SOP you personally created or improved.



What was wrong before, what did you change, and what measurable improvement resulted?





QUESTION 8:



Describe your experience managing sales staff or a sales department.



Include any targets, conversion figures, revenue targets or sales KPIs you monitored.





QUESTION 9:



Which CRM, project-management, finance and business-management systems have you used?





QUESTION 10:



Give an example of an important business problem you solved independently without waiting for the owner/CEO to tell you what to do.





QUESTION 11:



What Bachelor’s Degree or higher qualification do you hold, and which university awarded it?





QUESTION 12:



If you joined a company where the CEO was currently involved in too many daily tasks, what would you do during your FIRST 30 DAYS to reduce the CEO’s involvement while maintaining control of the business?





QUESTION 13:



Are you currently working for any other employer, client or business?



If yes, provide your working days and hours for EACH commitment.





QUESTION 14:



Are you available to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK time, 40 hours per week, without conflict with another job?





QUESTION 15:



Can you start within the next 7 days?





QUESTION 16:



Please provide your WhatsApp number including country code.





FINAL WARNING:



You must:



- Use at least 40 Apply Points

- Include code COO40-UKOPS26

- Answer ALL 16 questions

- Have at least 5 years relevant senior management / operations experience

- Be available full-time during UK working hours



Incomplete applications will not progress.

Applicants who clearly do not meet the mandatory requirements will not be invited to interview.

title: Are you a Rockstar Video Editor?
description:
𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗨𝘀:

Hi, I'm Harry, founder of AddSomeAI, a UK-based AI and automation development firm. We're among the longest running AI developers in the field.



We work directly with business owners, identify their biggest opportunities, and build tailored solutions to drive growth. We are experienced and confident in delivering bespoke solutions with AI and automation - now, we need someone to help us share that excitement with the world through video content to help it scale as well as take on creative edits for some of our clients.



You'll also edit for my dad's photography business, Two Front Teeth Photography. There's more on that role further down.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲:

You'll not only be creating innovative edits, but you'll also have the creative freedom to experiment with video concepts you think will grow the channel and dare we say it 'go viral!'. And your role isn't restricted to long form content, you'll be creating engaging short form content too from moments in the videos as well as dedicated short form footage.



Working directly with myself, the business owner / content creator, we really want to see someone who is excited to create the most engaging videos but most importantly, ones that not only help business owners but motivates them to take action to improve their business.



You'll be competent in Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing software. Adobe After Effects experience for motion effects is a great bonus to have.



We know how a lot of creators are concerned about the effect AI has in the creative industries, but being in this space for almost 2 years now we've seen it first hand. For us leveraging AI is just another tool we want to help you spend more time on flexing your creative muscles, and less time on the boring and simple parts. We'll be happy to help you keep up with the latest in AI, but it won't replace the creative and story telling eye from an editor we are looking for.



We've got examples of the style of edits we like, but if you have any ideas you want to put forward to us to that really showcase what you're capable of then you can share those later in the application process.



Here are a few of the edits we are looking for:

• 

• 

• 

• 



We've got a lot of content and ideas to share with you, we just need someone ready to take action! Although we are a small business, we are looking for someone to join us on this journey for the long run, so you'll need to be highly organised, pay meticulous attention to detail and be able to deliver to strict deadlines. We plan to increase the hours as we go and look to make this full time if we're happy with your work.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝘆:

Knowledge in AI is not required. We will provide all the resources you need to understand the fundamentals of what it is. What we need is your creativity, fresh ideas, storytelling skills and hunger for growth.



You'll work directly with the founder, gaining senior-level exposure to how a start-up scales. The role starts as flexible, part-time freelance work, project by project. If you help us take off, a full-time senior position and other benefits could be waiting for you.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗕𝗲 𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴:

• YouTube Explainers: Turning talking-head footage and screen recordings into a story people want to watch, with visuals that make each idea click.

• Client Interviews & Case Studies: Finding the strongest story and backing it up with B-roll, while keeping what the client said accurate.

• Shorts Packages: Spotting the standalone takeaways in a longer video and turning each one into a Short with a new hook, vertical crop and captions.

• AI Product Demos: Making each step easy to follow with zooms, highlights and simple animated diagrams.

• Real Estate Videos: Property tours, agent videos and social clips for the real estate clients we're lining up.



I handle the clients, so you'll get a clear brief for every project and all the feedback in one timecoded list. Before each project starts we'll agree the fee, deadline and deliverables, and on longer videos we'll sign off the structure before you spend time on graphics and polish.



𝗞𝗲𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀:

• Long-Form YouTube: Take full ownership of each video from raw footage to final delivery, usually 6 to 15 minutes long. That means a strong opening, a clear story with the repetition cut out, and an ending that lands. We're aiming for 4 to 8 a month.

• Retention: Keep people watching with varied pacing, relevant B-roll and visual explanations, and know when a pause works better than another cut.

• Motion Graphics & Sound Design: Add text animations with sound effects, plus animated titles, simple diagrams and screen highlights that explain an idea, all matching our tone and brand.

• Music: Choose and cut music that matches the mood and narrative of the story. We want people to feel something and come away motivated to take action in their business.

• Finishing touches: Clean speech, consistent audio levels, balanced colour and captions that are easy to read.

• Creative Freedom: Pitch your own concepts and hooks, and try new formats and editing styles. If you think something will work better, we want to hear it!



𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱 𝗥𝗼𝗹𝗲: 𝗧𝘄𝗼 𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘁 𝗧𝗲𝗲𝘁𝗵 𝗣𝗵𝗼𝘁𝗼𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗽𝗵𝘆

Alongside our AI content, you'll edit for Two Front Teeth Photography. They specialise in families, babies and dogs, and want videos that reflect their fun, friendly personality. You'll take their existing footage and turn it into something really special for
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.



• Social Videos: Fun, engaging edits with strong hooks, smooth transitions and animated captions, from dynamic text to kinetic typography.

• Social Ads: Ads that make people stop scrolling, watch and take action.

• Effects & AI Tools: Creative animations and visual effects, plus AI tools used creatively to enhance the footage.

• Sound Design: Music, sound effects and audio touches that bring each video to life.

• Creative Input: Bring your own ideas, and turn a simple idea into something memorable, entertaining and effective.



Most importantly, they're looking for imagination, creativity and a sense of humour.



𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁𝘀:

• You've edited real estate videos, or family, baby or pet content.

• You've edited social media ads for
, Instagram or TikTok.

• You've edited for AI, software, education or business creators.

• You've got Photoshop skills.

• You've designed or edited YouTube thumbnails, and you've got ideas for titles too.



Filming and 3D work aren't required.



𝗙𝘂𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗢𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝘀 𝘄𝗲 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘄:

• Video Ads: Cutting short video ads for our paid campaigns when they launch.

• Brand Templates: Building our own title cards, lower thirds, transitions and sound effects library. Anything where we want to keep the same style all the way through!

• Channel Growth: Going through the YouTube analytics with me to see where viewers drop off, and using what we learn to make the next video better.

• Leading Future Editors: As the team grows, helping new editors learn our style and standards.



𝗣𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀:

• Growth Mindset: You are excited by AI and ready to learn.

• Innovative: You're always trying new styles and effects, and you keep an eye on what's working for other creators.

• Storyteller: You can find the story in hours of raw footage and keep people watching to the end.

• Very Creative: You know how to research and produce an edit that captures people's attention and makes them go 'WOW!'

• Sense of Humour: You can make people smile, and you'd enjoy editing fun videos of families, babies and dogs.

• Organised: You keep tidy files and clear version numbers, treat client footage as confidential, and juggle several projects without missing a deadline.

• Clear Communicator: Your English is clear, you ask questions early, you give honest time estimates and you warn us about delays as soon as you see them coming.



We know the importance of having the best people, we truly are looking for A-Players, binding them in a culture that allows them to flourish & do their best work, whilst following a vision that is inherently worthwhile. We want to grow the team in the future, and your work will directly impact how soon we can do that! It's a lot of responsibility but you'll see the impact you'll make and learn with us fast!



We think big, grow together and celebrate wins.



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗨𝘀:

title: SQL Database Report Administrator
description:
About the Role



Are you passionate about data management, relational database architecture, and helping organizations transform complex data into actionable business intelligence? We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SQL Database Report Administrator to join our team and contribute to our data strategy and reporting infrastructure.



In this role, you will help design, optimize, and maintain database environments (with a focus on MySQL and relational systems), build robust reporting solutions, and ensure high availability and accuracy across our enterprise data systems. We are looking for someone who combines analytical thinking, deep technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills to support business-critical operations.



If you enjoy analyzing complex datasets, writing optimized queries, building interactive reports, and ensuring seamless database performance, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities



- Report Development & Design: Design, build, schedule, and maintain complex operational reports, interactive dashboards, and business performance metrics tailored to stakeholder needs.



- MySQL Database Administration & Maintenance: Manage, monitor, and maintain MySQL and relational databases to ensure optimal performance, data integrity, and uptime.



- Query Optimization & Performance Tuning: Write, refactor, and optimize complex SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and indexes to improve response times and streamline reporting queries.



- Data Integration & Pipeline Management: Support data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL/ELT) processes to aggregate data from multiple systems into unified reporting repositories.



- Database Security & Access Control: Manage user permissions, role-based access, and security configurations to protect sensitive data while maintaining easy access for authorized reporting.



- Data Audits & Quality Control: Conduct regular data audits, validate report metrics against raw database sources, troubleshoot discrepancies, and ensure overall data accuracy.



- Backup & Disaster Recovery: Execute routine database backups, recovery testing, and maintenance scripts to guarantee continuous data availability for key business metrics.



- Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Proactively track database metrics, identify system bottlenecks, and resolve technical issues affecting query and report generation speed.



- Stakeholder Collaboration & Documentation: Translate business requirements into functional data models, document database schemas and report definitions, and communicate insights to non-technical teams.



- Industry Trends & Modern Practices: Stay informed on advancements in MySQL administration, reporting platforms, cloud environments, and business intelligence practices.



- Qualifications and Requirements

Proven experience in reporting, business intelligence (BI), or database reporting administration.

- Strong hands-on experience with MySQL (or similar relational database management systems) and advanced SQL query writing.

- Demonstrated background creating, modifying, and automating reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or dedicated reporting suites.

- Solid understanding of relational database design, indexing strategies, data aggregation, and query performance tuning.

- Ability to analyze complex data structures and convert raw operational data into actionable insights for business leaders.

- Strong technical, analytical, and troubleshooting capabilities.

- Exceptional attention to detail and data validation skills.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple reporting priorities, work independently, and collaborate across cross-functional departments.



Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with MySQL optimization tools (e.g., EXPLAIN execution plans, slow query logs, MySQL Workbench).

- Proficiency in scripting languages (such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for reporting task automation and data processing.

- Experience with cloud database services (e.g., AWS RDS for MySQL, Google Cloud SQL, or Azure Database for MySQL).

- Knowledge of data warehousing models (e.g., star/snowflake schemas) optimized for high-performance reporting.

- Experience managing replication, high availability, or backup strategies for MySQL databases.

- Relevant industry certifications (e.g., MySQL Database Administrator certification, Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst, or Tableau Certified).



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a proactive professional who takes initiative, enjoys solving complex data challenges, and is committed to delivering accurate, actionable reporting. The ideal candidate can identify database bottlenecks, build scalable reporting frameworks, and contribute to strategies that drive data-informed decision-making.

We value accountability, collaboration, adaptability, and a results-oriented mindset.



How to Apply

If you have the technical skills and reporting experience to contribute to our business intelligence initiatives, we would love to hear from you.



Submit your updated résumé highlighting your relevant MySQL experience, reporting tools, and database administration accomplishments. Candidates whose qualifications align with the role will be considered for the next steps in our recruitment process.



Ready to take the next step in your data and reporting career? Apply today and become part of our team!

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About the Role



Are you passionate about search engine optimization, digital marketing, and helping businesses grow their online presence? We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SEO Specialist to join our team and contribute to our digital growth strategy.



In this role, you will help improve website visibility across search engines, identify opportunities to increase organic traffic, and implement effective SEO strategies that support business objectives. We are looking for someone who combines analytical thinking, technical knowledge, and creativity to deliver measurable results.

If you enjoy analyzing search trends, optimizing website content, and finding new ways to improve search engine performance, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

- Keyword Research: Conduct keyword research to identify relevant search terms, understand user intent, and uncover opportunities to improve organic rankings.



- On-Page SEO: Optimize website content, title tags, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and URL structures according to SEO best practices.



- Technical SEO: Identify and address technical issues affecting website crawling, indexing, site architecture, mobile usability, and page performance.



- Content Optimization: Collaborate on creating and improving website content to increase relevance, search visibility, and user engagement.



- SEO Audits: Conduct website audits to identify optimization opportunities and recommend actionable improvements.



- Performance Analysis: Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, click-through rates, conversions, and other relevant SEO metrics.



- Competitor Research: Analyze competitor websites and search performance to identify opportunities for growth.



- Link-Building Strategies: Support backlink analysis and develop strategies to strengthen website authority.



- SEO Reporting: Prepare performance reports, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and recommend data-driven improvements.



- Industry Trends: Stay up to date with search engine algorithm updates, SEO tools, and evolving digital marketing practices.



Qualifications and Requirements

- Experience in SEO, search engine optimization, or digital marketing.

- Solid understanding of keyword research, search intent, and on-page SEO.

- Knowledge of technical SEO principles, including crawling, indexing, and website structure.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
# Senior Marketing Manager



We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Senior Marketing Manager to own campaign execution across our ecommerce and consumer-products business.



This is a hands-on position requiring strong project management, clear communication, and the ability to keep multiple campaigns, internal teams, and external partners moving toward agreed deadlines.



You will work closely with the founder, who remains actively involved in marketing strategy and decisions. Within your area of responsibility, you will have authority to scope vendor work, set deadlines, approve creative, and d
 what is ready to launch. You will work with a lean team and must be comfortable doing the work directly.



**Main responsibilities**



- Plan and execute campaigns across paid social,
/SMS, retail, and organic channels, from initial brief through launch and performance review.

- Own the marketing calendar, including product launches, promotions, Black Friday, and seasonal campaigns.

- Break campaigns into clear tasks, working backward from launch dates to establish deadlines, dependencies, and owners.

- Track progress across projects, follow up with stakeholders, and resolve blockers before deadlines are missed.

- Manage agencies, freelancers, and contractors, including scoping work, reviewing deliverables, and replacing partners who do not meet expectations.

- Write clear creative briefs and provide actionable feedback to editors, UGC creators, and designers.

- Maintain a steady pipeline of creative assets for campaign testing.

- Coordinate with internal teams across ecommerce, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and organic content.

- Work with the ecommerce lead on landing pages, advertorials, and promotional offers.

- Review channel and campaign performance, identifying what to stop, scale, or improve.

- Evaluate campaign decisions using customer acquisition cost, customer lifetime value, marketing efficiency ratio, and contribution margin.

- Maintain organized records of campaign status, decisions, tests, results, and next steps.

- Provide regular updates to leadership and escalate significant delays or performance issues promptly.

- Build practical processes where needed to improve execution and accountability.



**Requirements**



- At least five years of marketing experience, with most of that experience in ecommerce or direct-to-consumer businesses.

- Proven experience managing campaigns from planning through execution and performance review.

- Exceptional organization and an established system for tracking tasks, deadlines, dependencies, and follow-ups.

- Experience directly managing agencies and freelancers, including addressing underperformance and ending vendor relationships when necessary.

- Strong understanding of ecommerce performance metrics and how marketing decisions affect profitability.

- Ability to interpret campaign results and recommend clear, practical next steps.

- Excellent spoken and written English, including the ability to write effective briefs, feedback, and progress updates.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and follow through without constant supervision.

- Comfort working closely with an actively involved founder and responding to direct feedback.

- Willingness to take ownership of problems, acknowledge mistakes, and adjust quickly.

- Availability for scheduled calls and time-sensitive campaign issues during agreed US Eastern Time working hours.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace.



You must be comfortable holding people accountable to deadlines, joining calls to resolve important issues, and communicating proactively when a project is at risk.



**Preferred experience**



- Familiarity with Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, Amazon Seller Central, and TikTok Shop.

- Experience with retail or marketplace channels alongside direct-to-consumer ecommerce.

- Experience coordinating creator-led and UGC-heavy creative campaigns.

- Experience with landing pages, advertorials, and conversion-rate optimization.

- Bilingual English/Spanish.



**What success looks like**



- Campaigns launch on schedule, with clear ownership and coordinated execution.

- Leadership can quickly see where each project stands, what is blocked, and what happens next.

- Risks and delays are identified early and addressed promptly.

- Agencies and freelancers deliver work that meets agreed quality standards and deadlines.

- Creative assets are ready in time to support launches and ongoing testing.

- Campaign decisions reflect performance data and business profitability.

- Internal teams stay aligned on promotions, launches, and priorities.

- Projects move forward without repeated reminders from leadership.

- Campaign reviews produce useful findings that improve future execution.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. Your résumé.

2. A brief description of your ecommerce marketing and campaign management experience.

3. Two examples of campaigns or launches you personally managed. Include the objective, channels involved, timeframe, team or vendors involved, results, and your specific contribution. You may anonymize company information.

4. A description of the system or tools you use to track projects, deadlines, dependencies, and follow-ups.

5. One example of how you handled an underperforming agency or freelancer, including the action you took and the outcome.

6. Your availability in US Eastern Time.

7. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining how you kept a complex campaign or launch on track.

8. The words **“Senior Marketing Manager”** in your application subject line.



**Applications without a video recording and relevant campaign examples will not be considered.**

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

title: AMS360 expert in Commercial Insurance Industry
description:
Hello,



I run Falcon Insurance of Michigan, a boutique commercial insurance brokerage focused on delivering white-glove level service to our clients.



Our business is growing tremendously right now, and we're looking for an AMS360 specialist & operations assistant to add to our team. We envision growing with this person and seeing them become our go-to AMS360 expert and one of our main operations leads!



This person must have hands-on experience with AMS360 and a solid understanding of the insurance industry, along with a passion for clean, accurate data.



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following:



Reliable high-speed Internet access

Computer with dual monitors (strongly preferred)

Headset suitable for taking phone calls

Webcam for occasional team calls and screen-share sessions



The winning applicant must absolutely have the following characteristics:



At least 2 years of hands-on experience using AMS360 daily

Comfortable navigating AMS360 customer, policy, and transaction records

Experience with policy downloads, activities/suspenses, attachments, and reporting in AMS360

Previous experience working in Insurance (extra points for commercial P&C insurance)

Understanding of commercial lines (GL, property, auto, workers comp, umbrella)

Experience with data cleanup, duplicate records, or migration projects

Very detail-oriented, and Deadline-obsessed

Fluent in English, both written and spoken (We regularly discuss complicated business insurance with our team and clients)

Able to explain AMS360 processes to non-technical team members

Tech-comfortable (Excel, Outlook, VoIP apps, carrier portals)

Comfortable building and logging details in spreadsheets

Trust-worthy, communicative and reliable



We would like this person to work full-time. It is important to note that the work hours are not limited to 8 hours per day, that is simply the minimum. Your work hours will depend on how efficiently you can work. You will be required to work normal business hours in our time zone. We're open from 9 AM - 5 PM EST every weekday.



The winning candidate will go through a 30-day trial wherein we'll further assess if you're a good fit for the company as well as if it's a good fit for you.



For our company to grow, everything must run on checklists / working procedures. You will be expected to:



Follow step-by-step procedures that already exist

Make suggestions on how to improve checklists and AMS360 workflows (when you see legitimate improvement opportunities - I may say yes or no)

Be able to grasp how the procedures are done, and be able to write an AMS360 procedure when asked to



Projects you'll be involved in include:



Auditing and cleaning up existing AMS360 data (duplicate customers, missing fields, incorrect policy info)

Entering and updating customers, policies, endorsements, and renewals in AMS360

Managing activities and suspenses so nothing falls through the cracks

Pulling and building AMS360 reports for our sales & service departments

Supporting our team with AMS360 questions and training

Helping set up and maintain AMS360 standards across the agency

Updating Spreadsheets

Other Miscellaneous tasks



Timeline:



Starting as soon as I find a qualified applicant; next few weeks would be nice, although I'm not going to rush the process. I need the right person in this position

30-day trial to begin; if we like each other we'll continue

You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:



Please provide
 address for future interviews

Description of your AMS360 experience, including which modules or tasks you used most. (3 sentences)

Description of previous insurance experience. (3 sentences)

Describe a data cleanup or process improvement project you completed. (3 sentences)

Reason why you think this job is a fit for you. (3 sentences)

title: Google Ads and Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Google Ads & Meta Ads Specialist



About Service Conversion



Service Conversion helps businesses grow through digital marketing, lead generation, automation, and technology. We are looking for a results-driven Google Ads and Meta Ads Specialist to help manage and optimize advertising campaigns for our clients.



Job Overview



We are looking for someone experienced in managing paid advertising campaigns on both Google Ads and Meta Ads 
 and Instagram).



The ideal candidate understands how to generate quality leads, manage advertising budgets, monitor campaign performance, and continuously improve results. You should be comfortable working with multiple client accounts, analyzing data, testing different strategies, and communicating campaign performance to the team.



This position requires someone who can take ownership of assigned campaigns, identify problems, and make data-driven decisions to improve performance.



Key Responsibilities



Google Ads Management

- Set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.

- Work with Search campaigns and other relevant campaign types.

- Conduct keyword research and identify negative keywords.

- Write and test effective ad copy.

- Monitor search terms, bidding strategies, conversion rates, and cost per lead.

- Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and reduce wasted ad spend.



Meta Ads Management

- Set up, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Build and test different audiences, creatives, ad copy, and campaign strategies.

- Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, cost per lead, and return on ad spend where applicable.

- Identify underperforming ads and implement improvements.

- Assist with creative testing and provide recommendations for new ad variations.



Tracking and Reporting

- Monitor campaign metrics, including spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, cost per lead, and conversion rates.

- Check that conversion tracking and campaign measurement are working correctly.

- Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking tools where required.

- Maintain accurate campaign reports and tracking spreadsheets.

- Identify trends, investigate performance issues, and recommend improvements.



General Responsibilities

- Manage multiple client campaigns and prioritize tasks effectively.

- Follow internal processes and maintain organized campaign records.

- Communicate progress, issues, and recommendations clearly.

- Stay up to date with changes to Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Take initiative and focus on measurable results rather than simply completing tasks.



Requirements



- Demonstrable hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Experience managing campaigns focused on lead generation.

- Understanding of campaign structure, targeting, bidding, budgets, and optimization.

- Ability to analyze performance data and make informed decisions.

- Familiarity with conversion tracking, pixels, and analytics.

- Strong written English and communication skills.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently.

- Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Willingness to provide examples of previous campaigns and explain the results achieved.



Experience working with service-based businesses, particularly home services such as HVAC, plumbing, or other local service companies, is a strong advantage.



Salary and Schedule



- Compensation: $3–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

- Hours: Approximately 40 hours per week for the full-time position.

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

- Compensation and responsibilities may grow as performance and capabilities are demonstrated.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction explaining your experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.

2. Which platform you consider your strongest and why.

3. Examples of campaigns you have personally managed, including the industry, campaign objective, approximate budget, and measurable results.

4. Your experience with conversion tracking, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Meta Pixel.

5. The tools and reporting systems you use to monitor campaign performance.

6. Your expected hourly rate and availability.



Applications that provide specific examples and measurable campaign results will be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who can demonstrate practical skills, take ownership of campaigns, and help our clients generate better results through effective advertising.

Creating, setting up, and launching Meta 
 and Instagram) advertising campaigns.

Uploading and organising static images, videos, headlines, primary text, and descriptions.



Thoroughly proofreading all ad copy before launching.



Ensuring no competitor brand names, product references, incorrect offers, or leftover competitor information remain.

Ensuring all prices, currencies, languages, and promotional offers are correct for the target market.



Checking that creatives, copy, headlines, and landing pages all match.



Verifying tracking configurations and campaign settings are correct.



Performing thorough quality checks before and after launching campaigns.



Identifying potential mistakes, inconsistencies, or improvements without needing to be told.



Keeping campaigns organised and communicating clearly with the team.



Qualifications and Skills



Highly experienced with Meta Ads Manager. You must already have strong, practical experience launching campaigns for e-commerce businesses.



Exceptional attention to detail. Nothing gets past you. Even the smallest mistake should be noticed and corrected before launch.



Independent and proactive. We don't want to micromanage or explain basic tasks. You should know your role inside out.



Marketing-oriented. You understand how e-commerce advertising works, including offers, creatives, landing pages, and conversions.



Passionate about processes and systems. You have a clear workflow and use checklists to ensure nothing is overlooked.



Technically confident. You understand Meta Ads Manager, campaign structures, tracking, and troubleshooting.



Fast but accurate. You can launch multiple campaigns efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



Accountable and reliable. You take ownership of your work and ensure tasks are completed to a high standard.



Excellent communication skills. You communicate clearly, ask questions when necessary, and keep the team updated.



Open to feedback. Even with extensive experience, you are always looking to improve your workflow and performance.



Experience Requirements



We are specifically looking for someone who has previous experience working with e-commerce brands, ideally within direct-response marketing or dropshipping.



You must be confident managing the entire campaign launching process independently.



Experience working with multiple ad accounts, high volumes of creatives, and different international markets would be a significant advantage.



We are not looking for someone who has simply watched tutorials or completed courses. We need someone with proven, hands-on experience.



You should be able to explain your existing campaign-launching workflow and the steps you take to ensure every detail is correct before an advertisement goes live.



Salary Expectations & Working Arrangement



Competitive hourly rate depending on experience and expertise.



Fully remote position.



Looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship.



Initial paid trial period to assess your skills, accuracy, and workflow.



Opportunity for increased compensation and additional responsibilities as the company grows.



Benefits



Work with an ambitious and growing international e-commerce company.



Fully remote work.



Long-term opportunity with consistent work.



Opportunity to grow within the company.



Work alongside an experienced e-commerce team.



Performance bonuses and opportunities for increased compensation based on results and quality of work.



Our Expectations



We take quality, accountability, and attention to detail extremely seriously.



We need someone who treats every campaign as though it were their own business and understands that even a small mistake can waste advertising budget.



You should take pride in delivering work that is accurate, organised, and thoroughly checked.

title: SEO, Authority & Outreach Specialist
description:
# SEO, Authority & Outreach Specialist



## About Us



We are a fast-growing digital health company building and growing consumer health brands. We’re looking for an SEO specialist who enjoys finding opportunities, improving organic visibility, building authority, and reaching out to websites, creators, and partners.



This is a hands-on role for someone who likes both SEO and outreach — not someone who only runs reports.



## Work Schedule & Compensation



* **Location:** Remote – Philippines

* **Schedule:** Monday to Friday, typically **2:00 PM–12:00 AM Philippine Time**

* **Compensation:** Approximately **$900 USD per month based on working the full schedule**

* **Payment:** Paid twice per month via Wise

* **Time Off:** 12 paid days off per year

* Long-term position with opportunities to grow as the marketing team expands



## Role Overview



You’ll help grow our organic search presence and online authority across our brands.



Your work will include hands-on SEO improvements, keyword and competitor research, backlink and guest-post outreach, reputation monitoring, digital PR opportunities, and finding new websites, communities, creators, and partnerships that can help grow the brands.



You’ll work closely with our content team and marketing supervisor.



## Key Responsibilities



* Perform on-page SEO improvements across existing website content

* Research keywords, search trends, competitors, and new content opportunities

* Identify pages that should be updated, expanded, or better optimized

* Find and pursue quality backlink and guest-post opportunities

* Conduct outreach to relevant websites, publishers, newsletters, and partners

* Monitor backlinks, brand mentions, lost links, and opportunities for link reclamation

* Help identify digital PR and expert contribution opportunities

* Monitor reviews, Reddit, forums, and other online conversations around our brands and industry

* Help manage citations, profiles, directories, and other offsite brand assets

* Research potential influencers, affiliates, creators, and partnership opportunities

* Maintain organized outreach and opportunity pipelines

* Track results and identify new SEO and authority-building opportunities

* Use AI and modern research tools to work faster, improve research, and increase the quality of your work



## Requirements



* Experience with SEO, link building, outreach, or digital marketing

* Good understanding of on-page and off-page SEO

* Strong research skills and attention to detail

* Strong written English and professional communication skills

* Comfortable reaching out to websites, publishers, creators, and potential partners

* Able to stay organized while managing multiple outreach opportunities and follow-ups

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of results

* Interested in learning and testing new SEO and marketing strategies

* Comfortable using AI tools as part of your everyday workflow



## Experience That Is a Plus



Experience with any of the following is helpful, but you do not need to know everything:



* Google Search Console

* Ahrefs or Semrush

* WordPress

* Google Analytics

* Link-building and outreach tools

* Reddit and online community research

* Guest posting or digital PR

* Influencer or affiliate outreach

* Local SEO and citation management



## Who We're Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious and resourceful.



You should be the type of person who can look at a website, search result, competitor, backlink profile, or online conversation and start finding opportunities.



We value people who take initiative, communicate clearly, stay organized, and continually look for smarter ways to get better results.

title: UGC Talent & Creator Partnerships Manager | $1,300–$1,800 USD/Month + Bonuses | Full-Time Remote
description:
# We're Hiring: Senior UGC Talent & Creator Partnerships Manager



### We're Looking for Someone With Two Exceptional Skills: Creative Taste & People Skills.



We're a fast-growing U.S. beauty brand building a high-volume content production engine.



We already have an experienced team of creative strategists who write scripts, develop advertising concepts, and analyze performance.



**Now we need someone who can find exceptional on-camera talent, build strong relationships with those creators, and turn them into reliable long-term partners.**



This isn't a typical influencer marketing or outreach position.



We're looking for someone with the creative judgment of a casting director and the relationship-building skills of a great talent manager.



Someone who knows the difference between a creator who just looks good on camera and one who can actually captivate an audience and sell a product.



And someone who can make talented creators genuinely excited to work with us.



### What Makes Someone Great at This Role?



**1. You Have Incredible Taste in UGC**



- You can immediately recognize strong on-camera personalities.

- You understand what makes a video engaging, believable, and persuasive.

- You can tell the difference between natural, high-performing UGC and generic, boring content.

- You know how to find creators who can bring scripts to life with emotion, personality, and authenticity.

- You understand direct-response advertising, not just influencer content.



**2. You're Amazing at Building Relationships**



- You're naturally great with people.

- You know how to build trust, make creators feel valued, and develop genuine long-term partnerships.

- You're a strong negotiator who can create deals that benefit both sides.

- You know how to motivate creators through retainers, bonuses, and recurring opportunities.

- You can turn a one-time collaboration into a dependable partnership.

- You understand that the best creators should feel like partners, not disposable freelancers.



### What You'll Be Responsible For



You'll own our UGC creator network from recruitment through production.



Your responsibilities include:



- Finding and recruiting talented U.S.-based UGC creators and actors.

- Auditioning, evaluating, and selecting creators based on their on-camera ability.

- Building a dependable roster of high-quality creators.

- Negotiating competitive rates, monthly retainers, video packages, and performance bonuses.

- Developing long-term relationships with our best talent.

- Matching creators to scripts prepared by our creative team.

- Managing creator communication, production schedules, deadlines, and deliverables.

- Providing constructive feedback and coordinating reshoots.

- Continuously finding better talent and improving production efficiency.



**Our initial goal is to build a creator engine capable of consistently producing 20+ approved UGC videos per week.**



You'll have access to a dedicated creator production budget and an existing team of creative strategists.



You will NOT be responsible for writing scripts or developing advertising concepts.



Your job is to find the right people, build strong partnerships, and make sure excellent content gets produced.



### What We're Looking For



We're particularly interested in someone who:



- Has experience managing UGC creators for DTC brands or performance marketing agencies.

- Has personally negotiated creator rates and recurring partnerships.

- Understands the U.S. creator market.

- Has strong creative instincts and excellent taste.

- Is confident communicating and negotiating in English.

- Is exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful.

- Can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Takes ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for instructions.



**Bonus points if you already have a network of U.S.-based creators, especially in beauty and skincare.**



### Why This Is a Great Opportunity



**You're not joining to follow an existing system. You're joining to build one.**



You'll have:



- Real ownership over an important part of a growing business.

- Direct collaboration with company leadership and our creative strategy team.

- A dedicated production budget to recruit and retain great talent.

- Freedom to build processes, creator relationships, and partnerships.

- Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses.

- An opportunity to grow into a larger leadership role as the creator network expands.



We're looking for someone who wants to build something long-term, not just complete another set of daily tasks.



Compensation & Opportunity



Base Salary: $1,300–$1,800 USD/month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Performance Bonuses: Additional earning potential based on creator quality, retention, and production performance.



Work Setup: Full-time, remote from the Philippines.



Schedule: Flexible hours with some overlap with U.S. business hours.



Growth: Opportunity to build and eventually lead our entire UGC talent network.



We're open to discussing compensation with exceptional candidates who have demonstrated experience and strong existing creator relationships.



### How to Apply



We care much more about your judgment, relationships, and proven results than your resume.



Please answer these questions:



**1. Show Us Your Taste**



Share 3 UGC video examples you think are exceptional for paid advertising.



Explain what makes the creators engaging and persuasive. Be specific.



**2. Show Us Your Relationships**



Tell us about a creator you recruited and developed a long-term relationship with.



How did you build that relationship? Why did they continue working with you?



**3. Show Us Your Experience**



How many creators have you managed simultaneously? How many UGC videos were you responsible for delivering per month?



**4. Show Us Your Negotiation Skills**



What's an example of a creator deal you negotiated successfully? What were the original rates and final terms?



**5. Show Us Your Sourcing Skills**



How would you find great U.S.-based female UGC creators aged 40–65+, particularly mature Black women?



**6. Tell Us About Yourself**



What is your expected monthly salary? When can you start? Why do you think you'd be exceptional at this role?



**Start your application with "CREATOR PARTNERSHIPS" so we know you've read the full posting.**



We're looking for someone exceptional at finding great people, building lasting relationships, and turning those relationships into consistently excellent creative.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital & E-commerce Assistant

title: Marketplace Performance & Operations Lead (Amazon SFP / TikTok Shop / eBay)
description:
Job title: Marketplace Performance & Operations Lead (Amazon SFP / TikTok Shop / eBay)



Location: Philippines (remote)



Brand: Buy It Direct (Trojan Commerce)



Department: Marketplace Operations (independent of Commercial)



Engagement: Full-time contract, indefinite term



Hours: 40 per week, 8:00am–4:30pm UK time



Monthly fee: Php120,000–Php150,000, depending on experience, plus KPI bonus



Reports to: CEO







About the role



Trojan Commerce, part of the Buy It Direct Group, runs 20 marketplace stores for international brands across Amazon, TikTok Shop and eBay in the UK and Europe.



We need a senior marketplace operator to take full ownership of those stores' performance. Your job is to keep every account healthy, every SLA met and every store's status protected, while making sure the operation stays profitable.



This is not a monitoring or reporting role. When a metric moves, we expect you to find out why, work out what it is costing us, fix the root cause using a structured approach such as DMAIC and 5 Whys, and make sure it does not come back. You will log into Seller Central, TikTok Shop Seller Center and Seller Hub yourself, dig into the data, change what needs changing and drive other teams to do their part.



We don't expect one person to run 30+ stores single-handedly. Part of this role is designing how the work gets done: mapping every workstream, measuring the time and volume each one takes, and building an evidence-based case for the admin and specialist support you need. You will then delegate effectively and stay accountable for the outcome.



This role focuses purely on marketplace operations and performance. Sales growth and client relationships sit with our Commercial team, who will rely on you to keep every store healthy and within KPI. You will report directly to the CEO, independent of Commercial, so operational standards are never traded off against short-term sales targets.





What you will be accountable for:



You will be measured on outcomes, not activity:



- No loss of status. Amazon Account Health, Seller Fulfilled Prime eligibility, TikTok Shop Shop Performance Score and eBay seller standards are maintained on every store.

- SLAs met on every account. Dispatch, valid tracking, on-time delivery, cancellation and response-time targets are met, and risks are caught before a threshold is breached.

- Refunds and returns kept below 2%. When they rise, you investigate the root cause (product, listing, carrier, warehouse or customer experience), fix it and prove the fix worked.

- Operations aligned to the forecast. Warehouse, carriers and internal teams are working to the right volumes, especially ahead of peak and promotional events, so demand never turns into late or failed orders.

- Fast, effective Plans of Action. Pre-emptive submissions, appeals and POAs to Amazon, TikTok Shop and eBay are written well and accepted first time wherever possible.

- Revenue protected. Revenue at risk is quantified for every issue and fixes are prioritised by commercial impact.

- A properly resourced operation. Every workstream is mapped and measured, so resourcing decisions are based on evidence of workload, time and value rather than opinion, and delegated work is delivered to standard.



Key responsibilities



- Account health and compliance

- Monitor account health across all 20 stores and act on emerging risks before they become warnings or suspensions.

Write Plans of Action, appeals and pre-emptive submissions, and personally handle policy, IP and listing issues where status is at risk.

- Root-cause investigation and fixes

- Investigate spikes in late dispatch, cancellations, defects, refunds and returns using order-level data and structured methods (DMAIC, 5 Whys, Pareto).

- Fix problems at source, whether listing, product, integration, warehouse, carrier or platform, and put controls in place so they don't return.



Operational alignment

- Make sure the warehouse, carriers and internal teams plan to the right forecast, especially for peak and promotional events.

- Own marketplace fulfilment and carrier settings, and lead the response to any i
 affecting orders.

Impact and reporting

- Quantify the revenue at risk for every issue and give the CEO a concise weekly Red / Amber / Green view of every store.

Track every fix through to a measured result.



Process and scale

- Build the SOPs, controls and early-warning reporting that stop performance depending on individuals.

Work with IT to fix feed, catalogue and integration problems.

- Workload, resourcing and delegation

- Map and measure the time and volume of every workstream, and present an evidence-based case for any extra admin support.

- Manage one direct report from day one and more as required, delegating with clear SOPs and quality standards.



Essential experience

-Applications that cannot show clear evidence of all of the following will not be progressed.

- 4+ years operating Amazon Seller Central hands-on, with deep knowledge of Account Health, Seller Fulfilled Prime and seller performance metrics (Order Defect Rate, Late Shipment Rate, Valid Tracking Rate, cancellation rate).

- At least 12 months' hands-on TikTok Shop operations experience, including Shop Performance Score, fulfilment and dispatch requirements, violations and appeals.

- Plans of Action you have personally written that resolved account health issues, suspensions or listing problems.

Responsibility for multiple accounts at once, ideally 10 or more stores, brands or clients.

- Examples of root-cause fixes you owned end to end, where you found the cause in the data, implemented the fix and can show the measurable result.

- Practical use of structured root-cause methods such as DMAIC, 5 Whys or Pareto analysis on real operational problems.

Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to put a revenue or margin figure on a problem and prioritise accordingly.

- Experience scoping and delegating work, including measuring workload, building a resourcing case and managing or directing others to deliver it.

- Working knowledge of how marketplaces connect to warehouse, carrier and order-management systems, enough to diagnose where a problem actually sits.

- Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to challenge and advise senior management with evidence.



Desirable experience

- eBay Seller Hub and seller standards.

- UK and EU marketplaces (Amazon UK/EU, TikTok Shop UK).

- Agency or multi-client experience managing account health for many sellers at once.

- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent.



Is this role for you?



- This role is for you if you have personally owned marketplace accounts, found the reason something went wrong and fixed it, and can tell us what that fix was worth.



This role is not for you if your experience is mainly in PPC or advertising, listing creation, customer service, general eCommerce management, sales growth or client account management, or supporting another marketplace manager. Job titles don't matter to us. If you were called a VA but personally owned and fixed account health for multiple sellers, we want to hear from you.



What we offer



- Monthly fee of Php120,000–Php150,000, depending on experience.

- Annual KPI bonus of up to one month's fee, based on the outcomes above: no loss of status, SLAs met, refunds and returns below 2%.

- 15 days' paid leave per year, rising by one day for each year of service to 20 days, plus your birthday off.

- Benefits allowance of Php4,000 per month.

- Fully remote, on a long-term, indefinite contract.

- A direct reporting line to the CEO, and the authority to shape how marketplace operations run across 30+ stores.

- One direct report from day one, with scope to grow the team where your workload case supports it.



How to apply:



Submit your CV with your answers to the two questions below (200–300 words each) in PDF File. Applications without these answers will not be considered.



1.) Describe a marketplace problem you personally identified, investigated and fixed. What was the root cause, how did you find it (which method did you use), what did you change, and what was the commercial impact?



2.) Tell us about a Plan of Action you wrote for Amazon or TikTok Shop. What was the issue, what did your POA say, and what was the outcome?



 to: 

Subject: Full Name_Marketplace Performance & Operations Lead (Amazon SFP / TikTok Shop / eBay)



Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical case study using sample marketplace data before the final interview.

The last line of your application must be exactly: Accuracy before speed.

title: YouTube Shorts QA & Operations Specialist (Part-Time | Wed & Sun Nights)
description:
Compensation: $50.00 USD / month base retainer + $25.00 USD / month performance bonus (awarded for 100% on-time scheduling, zero missed release slots, zero QA oversights, and accurate tracker updates).



Job Overview

We operate a high-volume, faceless short-form YouTube network and are hiring an assertive Operations & Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to manage video uploads, enforce production deadlines, perform technical quality control, and maintain our Google Sheets release tracker. You will act as the operational enforcer, reviewing incoming edits, rejecting flawed cuts, and holding editors strictly to deadlines.



Key Responsibilities



1. Pipeline Enforcement & Deadline Tracking

Monitor editor batch handoffs (7 videos per batch) at the fixed 20:00 GMT+8 deadline every Wednesday and Sunday.





Enforce late-fee deductions if batches are overdue, and escalate chronic delays directly to channel management.



2. The 6-Point Technical QA Gate

Inspect every submitted .mp4 file at 1.0x speed and reject non-compliant cuts with exact timestamps:



Zero AI Hallucinations: Strictly authentic real-world footage or high-end 3D graphics (zero warped AI visuals, distorted hands, or melting anatomy).





Resolution & Canvas: Native 1440x2560 (9:16) or 2048x1536 (3:4) with zero compression blur, pillarboxing/letterboxing, or third-party watermarks.





Pacing & Sync: Visual cut within the first 1.5 seconds, cuts every 2–3 seconds maximum, and subtitles locked 1:1 to audio.





Formatting: Captions placed strictly inside vertical safe zones with approved brand fonts and colors.





Outro CTA: Final 3–5 seconds must feature the interactive click-trigger animation: "My likes turn into [XXX]" aligned with the YouTube Shorts like button.







3. Uploads, Metadata & Release Scheduling

Format curiosity-hook titles using double punctuation (?? / !!), selective capitalization, and two terminal emojis (<60 characters total; description left blank).





Complete ad suitability self-certification ("None of the above") to ensure an instant green monetization icon.





Link the Related Video element to the latest published Short.





Schedule releases in GMT+08:00:







Slot 1 (Lunch Peak): 11:30 GMT+8





Slot 2 (Evening Prime): 19:30 GMT+8 (or 21:30 GMT+8 for Sunday batches)







4. Production Tracker Sign-Off & Channel Protection

In the master Google Sheet, switch Quality Status to Passed (Green) and tick the Posting Status checkbox [✔] once the video is scheduled.





Execute an immediate Delete Forever on any video flagged by YouTube for an 18+ age restriction, community guidelines strike, or red monetization lockout (except standard blocks like Russia).





Working Hours & Shift Schedule

Fixed Shifts: Every Wednesday and Sunday from 20:00 to 22:00 GMT+8 (2 hours per shift).





Total Time Commitment: 4 hours per week. No daytime check-in pings required.





Candidate Requirements

Proven experience managing YouTube Studio uploads, metadata, monetization self-certification, and scheduling locked to specific timezones.





Sharp technical eye for video errors, frame drops, low resolution, audio clipping, and AI artifacts.





High discipline with Google Sheets workflow tracking.





Assertive communication style to reject substandard creative work and hold freelancers to deadlines.





Reliable PC/Mac setup capable of playing 2.5K/4K vertical video smoothly.





How to Apply

To confirm you follow operational instructions closely, start your response with the word "BLUE" as the very first word.

Your experience managing YouTube Studio uploads and video QA.

Your experience working with production trackers.





Confirmation that you are fully available every Wednesday and Sunday from 20:00 to 22:00 GMT+8.

title: Sales Operations Assistant: CRM, Follow-Ups & Revenue Tracking (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
About the role



I'm a high-ticket sales closer for a fast-growing social media and content agency that works with music artists, DJs and labels, from independent artists to major names. I collect $150,000+ in sales every month. My job is to be on sales calls. Your job is to make sure no lead, follow-up or payment ever falls through the cracks.

You'll run the back office of my sales pipeline: the CRM, follow-ups with leads who didn't show or didn't buy yet, payment reminders for clients on payment plans, and daily reports on exactly where the money is. If you love spreadsheets, love organisation, and get satisfaction from turning a "maybe later" into a closed deal, this role is for you.

This is a long-term, full-time position with a performance bonus and room to grow as my sales team grows.



Schedule

• 6 days a week, Monday to Saturday

• 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Eastern Time (EST/EDT). This is a night shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if you can work these hours consistently.

• Fully remote. You need a reliable laptop, a stable internet connection and a backup option (mobile data or a power bank) for outages.



What you'll do every day



1. Start-of-day report (sent by 11:30 AM EST):

    ◦ Today's booked sales calls.

    ◦ Payments due today and this week.

    ◦ Leads that need follow-up today.

    ◦ Anything urgent.

2. CRM management: keep every lead up to date in Google Sheets. That means stage, next action, next action date, last contact, deal value, cash collected and notes. Every lead must always have a next step.

3. No-show follow-up: contact every lead who missed a call and rebook them, using approved message templates and a set follow-up sequence.

4. Lead reactivation: nurture leads who didn't buy on the first call, using text and
 sequences, and book them back in.

5. Payment tracking and reminders: track every instalment for clients on payment plans and send reminders before, on and after each due date. Flag anything late to me immediately.

6. Revenue tracking and forecasting: keep a live view of the following.

    ◦ Cash collected this month.

    ◦ Revenue sold.

    ◦ Payments still to collect.

    ◦ Forecasted cash for this week and this month.

    ◦ Progress against my monthly target.

7.
 follow-ups and re-engagement campaigns to past leads and no-shows.

8. End-of-day report (sent by 7:00 PM EST):

    ◦ Cash collected today and month-to-date.

    ◦ Sales calls taken and closed.

    ◦ Leads followed up and leads reactivated.

    ◦ Calls rebooked.

    ◦ Payments collected and payments outstanding.

    ◦ What's due tomorrow, this week and this month.



What you will NOT do



• Take card details or banking information. You only send official payment links.

• Offer discounts or negotiate prices.

• Make promises to clients about results.



Requirements



• 2+ years as a virtual assistant, sales assistant, sales admin, operations assistant or appointment setter, ideally for a US or UK business.

• Advanced Google Sheets or Excel: formulas (SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF), filters, conditional formatting, dropdowns and simple dashboards.

• Confident with Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive and Docs.

• Experience with a CRM (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive or similar) is a strong plus.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with a friendly, natural and professional tone. Your messages will go to US and UK clients.

• Extremely organised, detail-oriented and reliable. You do what you say, on time, without being reminded.

• Comfortable with numbers: you can tell the difference between revenue sold, cash collected and cash forecasted.

• Bonus: an interest in music, social media or content creation.



Pay

• Base salary: $1,000 USD per month during your first 30 days (paid trial), rising to $1,100 USD per month once confirmed.

• Performance bonus on top of your base, paid monthly. You earn a percentage of cash from deals you help close by rebooking or reactivating leads, plus a bonus for keeping payment collections on time. Strong performers can add a meaningful amount to their monthly pay.

• Paid monthly via Wise.

• Salary reviews after 3 and 6 months based on performance.



How to apply (READ CAREFULLY):



TO COMPLETE YOUR APPLICATION: 



1) Fill out the Google Form in full to submit the job application: 

2) Come back here, apply for the job on OnlineJobs, with a message saying 'PIPELINE PRO'



Any applications not following these instructions, will be automatically disqualified.



IF YOU DO NOT FILL OUT THE FORM, YOUR APPLICATION WILL NOT BE COUNTED.
