title: Virtual Assistant - Recruiting & Launch Operations (US Home Services Startup) - Part Time
description:
## Job Title



Virtual Assistant - Recruiting & Launch Operations (US Home Services Startup) - Part Time



## Pay



**$6 USD/hour, approximately 20 hours/week to start (roughly $500/month).**

Clear path to full-time (and a pay increase) once the business is live and booking jobs,

expected within a couple of months of hire. 



## Hours



**roughly 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM US Eastern Time**. We need you reachable during part of the US

business day, since most of the people you'll coordinate with (subcontractors, vendors)

are in North Carolina. Exact hours are flexible within that window - we'll agree on a

fixed daily schedule once hired. 



## About us



Claystone Home Services is a new pressure washing and dryer vent cleaning company

launching in Raleigh, North Carolina, USA. We're pre-launch: no bookings yet, building

the foundation. The owner runs the business remotely from overseas. This is our first

hire - a genuine ground-floor seat, not a role joining an established team.



## What you'll do (first 90 days)



**Subcontractor recruiting:**

- Recruit 1099 subcontractors from Angi and Thumbtack for the Raleigh area

- Screen applicants against a checklist we'll give you (experience, equipment, insurance,

  licensing)

- Schedule and help run intro calls, track candidates in a simple pipeline

- Follow up to collect signed agreements and insurance documents



**Google Business Profile coordination:**

- We're remote and don't yet have a local Raleigh address, which Google requires to

  verify a Business Profile. Your job is to research realistic options (not invent

  workarounds that could get the listing suspended - we'll give you the ground rules),

  track what each option requires, and manage the verification process once we have a

  real local address to work with (most likely a subcontractor's, once one is hired)





## What this grows into



Once the business is live, the role shifts toward day-to-day operations: triaging

incoming leads, coordinating bookings in our scheduling software (Zenbooker), customer

follow-up and review requests, and subcontractor scheduling. Full-time hours at that

point. **The operation will utilize a lot of automations and AI to take work off your hands and you will mostly oversee it rather than actual do it**



## Requirements



- Excellent written English - most of this job is written communication with

  US-based people

- Comfortable making and receiving phone or video calls with US subcontractors and

  vendors

- Organized, low-supervision self-starter. The owner is overseas in a different time

  zone, so you need to run with tasks and flag problems

- Experience with recruiting, scheduling, or operations coordination in any industry is

  a strong plus, especially experience with home services

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly: Slack, GoHighLevel and Zenbooker

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to take calls



## Nice to have



- Prior experience as a VA for a US home services, trades, or field-service business

- Experience with cold outreach, sourcing, or recruiting

- Any familiarity with Google Business Profile



## How to apply



Send all of the following:

1. Your resume

2. A short voice note or video (30 seconds is enough) introducing yourself in English



**Put the word CLAYSTONE at the very start of your application subject line.**

Applications without it are not reviewed - it's how we check you read the whole post

rather than mass-applying.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist - Direct hire
description:
Accounts Payable Specialist (Remote — Philippines)



Two things before you apply:



1. You must be able to work a U.S. Central Time (CST/CDT) schedule.

2. You must have real accounts payable or accounting experience.



About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based outsourced accounting firm looking for a sharp, dependable Accounts Payable Specialist to manage vendor bills, payment processing, vendor reconciliations, and AP records across a portfolio of U.S. clients.



This is not a basic data-entry position. You will be responsible for making sure bills are accurately coded, recorded in the correct accounting period, supported by proper documentation, and paid according to established schedules and client approval procedures.



You will work directly with U.S.-based clients, vendors, and internal team members. We need someone who communicates clearly, follows through on outstanding items, protects client funds, and understands the importance of accurate financial records and timely payments.



We value people who take ownership of their work, exercise sound judgment, and flag discrepancies or potential problems instead of making assumptions or allowing issues to go unresolved.



What You’ll Own



Vendor Bills and Invoice Processing



* Receive, review, and process vendor invoices across multiple client accounts.

* Verify invoice details, vendor information, amounts, supporting documentation, and payment terms.

* Code invoices to the correct general ledger accounts, jobs, departments, or expense categories.

* Ensure bills are recorded in the appropriate accounting period.

* Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect charges, missing documentation, and other discrepancies before posting.

* Follow up with clients and vendors to obtain missing invoices, receipts, approvals, and supporting information.

* Maintain organized and complete digital records of invoices and related documentation.



Vendor Reconciliations and Issue Resolution



* Reconcile vendor statements against recorded bills, credits, and payments.

* Investigate discrepancies between vendor statements and accounting system balances.

* Research missing bills, unapplied credits, duplicate charges, and payment differences.

* Communicate professionally with vendors and clients to resolve outstanding issues.

* Track unresolved discrepancies and follow up until they are resolved.

* Maintain accurate vendor records and support documentation.



Payment Processing



* Prepare payment runs according to established schedules, payment terms, and client procedures.

* Process approved payments through checks, ACH, and wire transfers, as authorized.

* Verify payment details and supporting documentation before processing payments.

* Confirm that invoices have the appropriate approvals before they are included in payment runs.

* Identify duplicate payments, unusual payment requests, and potential fraud indicators.

* Maintain accurate payment records and ensure payments are applied to the correct vendor bills.

* Communicate upcoming payment deadlines, cash requirements, and urgent payment issues to the appropriate client contact.

* Escalate exceptions rather than bypassing approval procedures.



Job Costing and Accounting Accuracy



* Ensure job completion entries and related AP information are recorded accurately.

* Verify that expenses are assigned to the correct jobs, projects, or cost categories when applicable.

* Research discrepancies between vendor bills, job records, and accounting entries.

* Correct errors through approved accounting procedures and maintain appropriate supporting documentation.

* Help keep AP records current and accurate in preparation for month-end close.



Reporting and Client Support



* Maintain accurate AP aging reports and lists of outstanding vendor bills.

* Identify upcoming due dates, overdue bills, and invoices requiring client action.

* Provide clear updates on payment status and unresolved vendor issues.

* Support month-end AP reviews by ensuring invoices, credits, and payments are recorded correctly.

* Manage competing deadlines across multiple client accounts.

* Communicate proactively when information is missing or a deadline is at risk.

* Follow established workflows and document completed work consistently.



What We’re Looking For



* At least 2 years of hands-on accounts payable, accounting, or bookkeeping experience.

* Practical knowledge of the full AP cycle, including invoice processing, general ledger coding, vendor reconciliations, and payment preparation.

* Experience with accounting software, preferably QuickBooks Online.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with U.S. clients and vendors.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently.

* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines.

* A high level of integrity and respect for financial controls, payment approvals, and confidential information.

* A proactive mindset and the ability to follow through without constant supervision.

* Reliable internet access and a suitable remote-work environment.

* Ability to consistently work a U.S. Central Time schedule, including applicable daylight saving time changes.



Preferred qualifications:



* Experience supporting a U.S.-based accounting firm, bookkeeping firm, or BPO accounting team.

* Experience managing AP for multiple businesses simultaneously.

* Familiarity with Syncore or similar accounting and workflow platforms.

* Experience with job costing, project-based accounting, or businesses with inventory and operational expenses.

* Familiarity with ACH, wire transfers, vendor payment portals, and electronic payment controls.



What We Offer



* Stable, full-time, long-term remote employment.

* Direct exposure to U.S. clients and real-world accounting operations.

* A collaborative team environment with clear processes and opportunities to learn.

* Training and professional development opportunities.

* Performance-based compensation reviews that recognize accuracy, accountability, and consistent results.

* Career growth opportunities as our organization expands.



Work Schedule and Compensation



* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Employment: Full-time

* Schedule: Monday–Friday, aligned with U.S. Central Time business hours, including applicable daylight saving time changes.

* Monthly salary: depending on experience and qualifications.



How to Apply



To be considered, please include your resume and a link to a short video answering the following questions:



1. What are the two most important qualities of an effective accounts payable specialist, and why?

2. You are managing AP for several clients. Multiple invoices are due, one vendor statement does not match the accounting records, and a client has not approved a payment. How would you prioritize and handle these situations?

3. Tell us about a real accounting or AP discrepancy you encountered. How did you investigate it, resolve it, and prevent it from happening again?



Include links to both your video and your resume in your cover letter.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career, takes pride in accurate work, communicates proactively, and can be trusted to manage responsibilities independently.



Please apply only if you have relevant hands-on experience and can consistently work the required U.S. Central Time schedule.

title: Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager – Beauty Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
This is a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role with an ambitious, fast-growing Australian beauty brand.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Ecommerce Marketing Manager to own and accelerate the brand’s direct-to-consumer growth. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who can turn customer insight, creative ideas and performance data into stronger conversion, more efficient acquisition and sustained sales growth.



Focus: Ecommerce growth | Platform: Shopify | Channels: Paid, CRM and web



ABOUT THE BRAND



We are an age-positive Australian beauty brand creating high-performing, uncomplicated products for women who want beauty to feel relevant, joyful and real. We are building a distinctive brand with ambitious growth plans across Australia and international markets.



THE ROLE



You will lead the ecommerce growth engine across Shopify, paid media, CRM and onsite conversion. You will work closely with the social and creative teams to turn brand stories, customer problems and cultural moments into high-performing ads, hooks, landing pages and campaigns. You will be equally comfortable setting the strategy, briefing creative, managing activity in platform and digging into the numbers to d
 what happens next.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Ecommerce and Shopify ownership:

- Own the day-to-day performance and commercial growth of the brand’s Shopify store.

- Manage site merchandising, product launches, collections, promotions and campaign updates, ensuring the customer journey is seamless from landing page to checkout.

- Build and maintain a conversion optimisation roadmap across product pages, landing pages, bundles, offers, navigation, mobile experience and checkout.

- Use customer behaviour, site analytics and testing to identify friction, prioritise improvements and increase conversion rate and average order value.

- Coordinate developers and agency partners, writing clear briefs and ensuring work is delivered accurately and on time.



Paid media and profitable growth:

- Own paid performance strategy and execution across Meta and Google, including campaign structure, budgets, optimisation, testing and in-platform management.

- Set clear growth targets and manage spend against revenue, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, contribution margin and new-customer growth.

- Build a disciplined testing program across audiences, offers, formats, landing pages, hooks and creative concepts.

- Scale winning campaigns while protecting efficiency, and act quickly when performance changes.

- Translate channel data into clear actions and commercial recommendations for the leadership and wider team.



Creative strategy and campaign development:

- Work closely with social, brand and creative teams to build the advertising strategy, creative pipeline and campaign calendar.

- Develop sharp customer-led hooks, briefs and testing angles that connect the brand’s brand voice with clear product benefits and reasons to buy.

- Analyse creative performance to identify which messages, formats, talent and concepts drive sales, then feed those learnings back into content production.

- Write and refine on-brand copy for ads,
, landing pages and web campaigns.

- Ensure campaigns land consistently across paid ads, organic social,
, website and retail touchpoints.



CRM and customer growth:

- Own
 and CRM in Klaviyo, including campaign planning, automations, segmentation, testing, creative and reporting.

- Grow customer lifetime value through effective welcome, education, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and loyalty journeys.

- Use customer data and insights to improve retention, repeat purchase and the relevance of the brand’s communication.



Reporting, SEO and optimisation:

- Create a clear weekly trading and performance view covering revenue, traffic, conversion, average order value, channel efficiency, customer acquisition and retention.

- Own the digital trading rhythm, identifying risks and opportunities early and recommending the actions required to hit sales targets.

- Support SEO and content strategy, including the brand’s menopause and perimenopause education hub, working with agency partners and developers.

- Build a culture of testing and learning, with documented hypotheses, results and next steps.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Consistent, profitable growth in online revenue and new-customer acquisition.

- Improved Shopify conversion rate, average order value and customer lifetime value.

- A reliable creative testing engine with a steady pipeline of new hooks and winning ad concepts.

- Stronger paid media efficiency and confident scaling of spend.

- Clear, actionable reporting that helps the team make faster commercial decisions.

- Well-executed launches and campaigns delivered seamlessly across all digital touchpoints.



ABOUT YOU



- Fluent English, spoken and written (essential)

- Senior ecommerce or growth marketing experience in a high-growth beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness or consumer brand, with a strong record of increasing online sales.

- Deep, hands-on Shopify experience and a strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising, customer journeys and conversion optimisation.

- Highly experienced in paid social and paid search, particularly Meta and Google, with the ability to manage campaigns directly rather than relying entirely on agencies.

- Experience applying proven ecommerce growth frameworks, with strong testing discipline and growth methodology.

- Strong Klaviyo and CRM experience across campaigns, automations, segmentation and retention strategy.

- A proven ability to use data to make decisions, prioritise activity and explain performance clearly to non-specialists.

- Strong creative judgement and experience partnering with social and creative teams to develop performance-led concepts, hooks and briefs.

- Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with a sharp understanding of brand tone and customer motivation.

- Commercially minded, highly organised and comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Proactive, accountable and calm under pressure, with the confidence to challenge, recommend and act.



HIGHLY REGARDED



- Experience growing a beauty brand across Australia and the United States.

- Experience with subscription, bundles, gifting, loyalty or referral programs.

- Working knowledge of GA4, attribution tools, dashboards, SEO and Shopify analytics.

- Experience managing agency, freelance and developer relationships.



HOW WE WORK



This role suits someone who loves pace, ownership and visible commercial impact. You will be expected to bring ideas, test them quickly, learn from the results and work generously across brand, creative, social and operations. Here, strong performance and strong brand building should reinforce each other.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send your CV and a short note outlining the ecommerce growth you have personally driven. Include examples of Shopify conversion improvements, paid media results, creative testing programs and the ecommerce growth frameworks you have used.

We don't need complicated motion graphics or excessive effects. We'd much rather work with an editor who can turn simple footage into a compelling story that keeps viewers engaged.

• Following established creative direction and content references, including Matt Hannan's content 



• Collaborating with our creative team, applying feedback, and consistently meeting deadlines

We're looking for a sharp, resourceful, and results-driven eCom Recruitment Specialist who knows how to find exceptional talent — especially the candidates who aren't actively looking for their next opportunity.



This is not a role for someone who simply posts jobs, screens resumes, and waits for applications.



We need a recruiter who can proactively headhunt, assess talent beyond what's written on a CV, understand what makes someone successful in an eCommerce business and confidently recommend candidates to our clients.



You'll take ownership of multiple recruitment searches, build strong candidate pipelines, and help us consistently deliver high-quality shortlists to fast-growing brands.



If you love recruiting, understand the eCommerce ecosystem, and take pride in finding talent others struggle to find, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do

- Manage assigned searches from role intake, sourcing strategy, headhunting, screening, and candidate assessment through shortlisting, interview coordination, and successful placement.

- Proactively identify and engage high-caliber candidates through LinkedIn, professional communities, industry networks, referrals, talent databases, and creative sourcing channels.

- Build pipelines for positions across performance marketing, creative strategy, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and leadership.

- Conduct structured interviews, evaluate relevant industry experience, validate accomplishments, and identify candidates who can genuinely perform at the level our clients expect.

- Continuously expand, organize, and nurture our candidate database, maintain accurate recruitment records, and contribute to improving our recruitment systems and processes.



Who We're Looking For

-  Hands-on recruitment experience, ideally within eCommerce, DTC, digital marketing, or fast-growing remote businesses.

- Understand the roles, functions, terminology, and performance expectations within DTC and eCommerce organizations.

- Comfortable using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards, talent communities, and outbound outreach to identify hard-to-find candidates.

- Organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple searches while maintaining strong communication, accurate tracking, and fast turnaround times.

- You've successfully recruited for eCom brands or agencies supporting them

title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
Position Summary

Ashoori Law is a U.S. immigration law firm based in Los Angeles. It works with a national network of independent immigration attorneys. We're hiring a Video & Graphics to own the visual side of our marketing, from the weekly YouTube video to the graphics that go with every post.



In this role, you'll edit one long-form YouTube video a week and cut it into short clips for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. You'll also design the thumbnails, social graphics, carousels and blog images for our website and social channels. You'll work in Premiere Pro (or similar), Photoshop and Canva, and you'll build and maintain the templates the marketing team uses for everyday content.



Because we’re an immigration law firm, every video and graphic goes through an accuracy and compliance review before it's published. The right person takes detailed feedback well, applies edits precisely, and makes educational immigration content clear and engaging without overstating anything. You'll report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with the content, social, SEO and web development team.



Core Responsibilities

Video Editing

Edit long-form YouTube video per week, turning scripts, raw footage, graphics and other source material into a polished final production.

Cut each long-form video into 3-5 short clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with captions, a strong opening hook and a closing call-to-action card.

Edit scripted short-form videos, client testimonial videos and firm introduction videos.

Add captions, lower thirds, on-screen text, b-roll, motion graphics, intros, outros and end cards, and handle audio cleanup and color correction for a consistent, professional look.

Apply reviewer notes precisely and completely, and provide an updated transcript after each revision round.

Keep project files, raw footage and final exports organized in the shared drive.

Deliver high-quality work on a consistent weekly schedule, with quick turnaround on revisions.

Graphic Design

Design YouTube thumbnails, Reel and TikTok covers, and testimonial video thumbnails.

Create social graphics and carousels for Instagram,
 and 
 from blog posts, FAQs and approved client reviews.

Produce blog featured images and text-based infographics and tables for the website, optimized for web performance.

Build and maintain a Canva template library so the marketing team can produce recurring content quickly and consistently.

Support the firm's brand refresh and website redesign with visual assets, including photo retouching and consistent backgrounds on attorney headshots.

Editorial & Brand Standards

Use sound editorial judgment to create content that is clear, accurate and engaging for people navigating immigration questions.

Make sure all videos and graphics follow Ashoori Law's brand guidelines and the legal advertising rules for law firms.

Submit all work through the firm's accuracy and compliance review before publishing, and implement required changes promptly.

Follow YouTube and social platform community guidelines and content policies.

Work with the marketing, content, social, SEO and web development teams so content meets creative and strategic goals.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay current on YouTube and short-form editing best practices, thumbnail trends, audience behavior and new content formats.

Review high-performing immigration and legal education content for format and style ideas, without copying anyone's wording or creative.

Use performance data (click-through rate, watch time, engagement) to improve thumbnails, hooks and pacing over time.

Suggest improvements to editing workflows, templates and production efficiency.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience of professional video editing and graphic design experience

A portfolio showing edited YouTube videos, short-form vertical videos, thumbnails and social graphics or carousels.

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro), Adobe Photoshop and Canva.

Experience editing educational, talking-head or explainer content for YouTube.

Working knowledge of platform formats and specs, including 16:9, 9:16 and 4:5, safe zones and caption styles.

Strong attention to detail, especially with on-screen text, spelling and accuracy.

Ability to take detailed feedback and implement revisions precisely and on deadline.

Strong organization and project management skills; able to juggle a weekly video alongside ongoing design requests.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Reliable internet connection and availability during PST business hours.



Preferred

Experience creating content for law firms, legal media, or other regulated industries such as finance or healthcare.

Familiarity with YouTube Studio analytics and thumbnail testing.

Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics experience.

Adobe Illustrator 



What Success Looks Like

One polished YouTube video and its short-form clips delivered on schedule every week.

Thumbnails and graphics that are on-brand, consistent and improving in click-through rate and engagement over time.

Reviewer notes applied correctly the first time, with fewer compliance revisions as you learn the firm's standards.

A working template library the marketing team relies on for everyday content.

Multiple projects and deadlines handled with strong organization and attention to detail.

Effective collaboration with the content, social, SEO and web development team.

New editing techniques, formats and creative ideas that keep Ashoori Law's content clear, competitive and engaging.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 and safe, routine website troubleshooting.

- Clear written English, reliable follow-through, and the ability to explain technical issues in plain language.

- Reliable internet and an agreed weekday overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours.



USEFUL EXPERIENCE



Experience with local service businesses, WhatConverts, WordPress, Google Tag Manager, The Customer Factor, Zapier, NiceJob, Google Business Profile, short-form video editing, and responsible AI-assisted work is helpful.



Please identify which tools you have actually used.



HOURS AND PAY

- Starting rate: $12 USD/hour.

- Exact shift, response expectations, and payment arrangements agreed before starting.

- Meetings, training, and documentation count toward paid hours.

- Extra hours require advance approval.

- No all-day or 24/7 availability is implied.



SELECTION AND EVALUATION



Shortlisted finalists will complete a paid, time-limited practical assessment using redacted or simulated materials. Scope and payment will be agreed in advance.



The selected candidate will begin a four-week paid evaluation: up to 80 hours, totaling $960 in labor at the stated rate.



Assessments and the evaluation do not guarantee an ongoing engagement, pay increase, or full-time role. Engagement terms will be agreed before work starts.

Week 2: Approved tracking checks and safe troubleshooting.

We evaluate judgment, accuracy, communication, and delivery—not guaranteed revenue in four weeks.



ACCESS AND APPROVALS

No unauthorized spending, campaign launches, purchases, bulk messages, ownership changes, or transfers. Do not remove existing provider access. Significant technical changes require approval and appropriate backup and testing.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not a phone-sales, cold-calling, appointment-setting, or general customer-service role.



It is not unlimited IT support or an unsupervised takeover of existing accounts.

Marketing Operations — F&S

Requirements

description:
We’re looking for an experienced marketer who can get to know a business, identify where its marketing can improve, and put together a practical plan to move it forward.



You’ll be a part of doing this for our Agency and our clients. That means researching companies and their customers, developing strategies, and turning those strategies into website improvements, content, campaigns, and clear next steps for our team.



We need someone who can make thoughtful recommendations, explain them to a client, and follow through. You should be comfortable doing hands-on work, coordinating with specialists, and checking that the finished result does what we intended.



AI should already be part of how you work. We want someone who is actively finding useful ways to save time, improve quality, and make recurring work easier for the whole team.



Research / Planning



- Learn how a business makes money, who its customers are, what those customers need, and how it compares with competitors.

- Review its website, industry and marketing to identify opportunities and problems worth addressing.

- Develop a strategy with clear priorities, supported by research and available data.

- Break that strategy into specific tasks, with realistic deadlines, responsibilities, and measures of success.

- Recommend where to focus our effort and what can wait.



Websites, Content, and Campaigns



- Recommend improvements to website messaging, navigation, service pages, landing pages, forms, and calls to action.

- Plan and help produce content, case studies,
s, newsletters, and supporting social content.

- Give writers, designers, and developers clear direction and enough context to do their work well.

- Write or revise copy when needed.

- Review finished work, coordinate approvals, and check that everything works correctly once it goes live.



HubSpot & Marketing Operations



- Work with HubSpot contacts, lists, forms,
s, workflows, lead routing, and reports.

- Help ensure inquiries reach the right person and receive appropriate follow-up.

- Coordinate technical support when needed and test the completed work.

- Keep useful documentation so someone else can understand and maintain what you’ve built.



Reporting & Interfacing



- Prepare and oversee regular marketing reports, checking contributions from other team members.

- Explain what changed, what the results mean, and what you recommend doing next.

- Connect reporting to meaningful business goals, including qualified inquiries and opportunities.

- Participate confidently in client meetings, ask good questions, and explain recommendations in plain English.

- Record decisions and follow up on commitments, approvals, and outstanding questions.



AI and Integrations



- Use AI regularly for research, planning, drafting, analysis, reporting, and other appropriate tasks.

- Develop reusable workflows and templates that make recurring work faster and more consistent.

- Check facts, calculations, and recommendations before using or sharing AI-generated work.

- Recognize when an output needs more research, correction, or human judgment.

- Share useful approaches with the team and help others adopt them.

- Handle company and client information responsibly.



Keeps Progressing



- Manage your priorities and deadlines without repeated reminders.

- Keep the team informed about progress, missing information, and decisions needed.

- Raise problems early, with a suggested way forward.

- Coordinate work with colleagues and outside specialists.

- Make handoffs clear: what is finished, what remains, who owns the next step, and when it is due.



**What we’re looking for**



- Five or more years of relevant digital marketing experience, with examples of work you’ve owned from planning through delivery.

- Experience researching a business and turning what you learn into a useful marketing strategy.

- Strong understanding of website content, SEO, conversion improvement,
 marketing, and performance measurement.

- Practical HubSpot experience, including workflows, segmentation, forms, campaigns, and reporting.

- Familiarity with WordPress, HubSpot Content Hub, GA4, GSC, GTM, Semrush, SE Rankings and Ahrefs.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to discuss strategy and results with US-based clients.

- Experience managing several accounts or projects at once. Agency experience is a plus.

- Established AI workflows you can demonstrate and explain.

- Good judgment, attention to detail, and a dependable approach to remote work.



We care about what you can demonstrate: the decisions you made, the work you delivered, and what you learned from the results.



Schedule and Working Arrangements



This is a remote position based in the Philippines. You’ll need consistent availability during our US Eastern business hours for team collaboration, client meetings, and timely communication.



We’ll agree on the exact schedule before hiring. It will include evening or overnight hours in the Philippines. You’ll also need reliable internet, a suitable space for video calls, and backup arrangements for power or connectivity interruptions.



**What doing this job well looks like**



You bring us clear recommendations and turn them into completed work. Coworkers are accessible to to for co-working, consult and guidance. Clients understand what we’re doing and why. Reports help us d
 what to do next. Deadlines are managed, problems are raised early, and the team can rely on your follow-through.



Over time, the processes and AI workflows you build should help us deliver better work with less repetition and rework.



Interested?



Send your résumé, expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos, and availability during US Eastern business hours. Please also include:



- An example of a business you researched, the strategy you recommended, and the website or campaign work that followed.

- A report or presentation you prepared, with a brief explanation of your contribution.

- Two examples of how you currently use AI at work, how you check the output, and what the process has improved.



Please remove confidential information from any samples. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to walk us through their work and complete a short, paid practical exercise. Recruiters, auto-submitted applicants and complete ai-generated responses will be deleted.If you want a real career with good pay and opportunity then show that.

title: Business Development / Sales
description:
Noble Hearts HR Consulting & Staffing, | Base + Commission



About Us

Noble Hearts HR Consulting & Staffing is a U.S.-based, M/WBE-certified HR consulting and staffing firm. We help businesses across the Southeast with fractional HR support, recruiting, hiring events, and workforce training. We're growing our client base and looking for a driven business development professional to help us bring on new clients.



The Role

This is a base + commission, independent contractor role focused entirely on acquiring new clients. You'll prospect, pitch, and close new business — no cap on what you can earn as your results grow.



You control your schedule. This role requires a minimum of 30 hours per week directed toward prospecting and client development, worked whenever fits your day.



This is a business development role! You'll be expected to research, prospect, and develop warm leads and support closing deals.



What You'll Do

Identify and prospect new business targets within the SC / GA / FL / NC / NY and Virginia territory

Run outbound outreach — calls,
, LinkedIn — to generate qualified conversations

Present Noble Hearts' HR consulting, recruiting, and staffing services to prospective clients

Pass forward real warm leads for new client agreements and support the transition to onboarding

Track all pipeline activity in the CRM provided



Compensation



Base Rate (Hourly):



Starting rate $3.00/hour

After your first new client closes and their payment is collected $3.25/hour

After 2 consecutive quarters hitting the revenue goal $3.50.00/hour

After 4 consecutive quarters hitting the revenue goal $4.00/hour



Plus, for every new client you close:



$25 for a new recurring/fractional HR client

$25 for a new project-based engagement (recruiting search, hiring event, training)

Paid within 15 days of Noble Hearts receiving the client's first payment



Tools Provided



CRM for pipeline and client tracking

UpLead for contact and company-level prospecting data

LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Juiceboc for outreach



What You'll Need



A persuasive, charismatic, and confident communication style.

Ability to help people see potential and possibilities.

Minimum 3 years of business development, outbound sales, or new client acquisition experience specifically targeting the U.S. market

Ability to independently research, prospect, and engage U.S. businesses with minimal day-to-day direction

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Your own computer, reliable internet, and a phone

Self-discipline to consistently hit the 30-hour/week minimum without close supervision

title: GoHighLevel Specialist & Operations Manager
description:
The GoHighLevel Specialist will serve as the business owner's right-hand partner, leading GHL operations, coordinating team execution, managing projects, and improving day-to-day business operations. The role requires a proactive, technically skilled, and business-minded professional who can work independently, solve problems, and turn business priorities into measurable results.



Key Responsibilities:

* Owner Support and Project Management: Translate business goals into actionable plans, manage priorities and deadlines, monitor project progress, and provide regular updates and recommendations to the owner.

* GoHighLevel (GHL) Management: Build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize CRM systems, pipelines, automation workflows, funnels, landing pages,
/SMS campaigns, and account configurations.

* Team Leadership and Coordination: Assign and monitor tasks, guide and train team members, review deliverables, maintain accountability, and improve team communication and performance.

* Automation and Integrations: Integrate GHL with third-party platforms using Zapier, Make, APIs, and webhooks to streamline processes and reduce manual work.

* Operations and Process Improvement: Support client onboarding and project delivery, develop SOPs and documentation, monitor KPIs, conduct quality assurance, and implement scalable operational systems.



Required Qualifications

* Proven hands-on experience with GoHighLevel and its core features.

* Strong knowledge of CRM architecture, automation workflows, pipelines, funnels, and marketing campaigns.

* Demonstrated experience in project management, team coordination, and completing projects on time.

* Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including written and verbal English.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, take initiative, make sound decisions, and handle confidential information professionally.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment with strong accountability, attention to detail, and follow-through.





Preferred Qualifications

* Experience as an executive assistant, operations coordinator, project manager, team lead, or operations manager.

* Experience supporting business owners, CEOs, founders, or agency leadership.

* Experience managing multiple GHL accounts and implementing CRM solutions for an agency or SaaS business.

* Knowledge of Zapier, Make, APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

* Familiarity with sales operations, lead generation, appointment setting, and client onboarding.

* Experience creating SOPs, training teams, and implementing quality assurance processes.

* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.





Key Success Factors

* Think strategically while remaining hands-on with technical implementation.

* Take ownership of projects and deliver results with minimal supervision.

* Lead and coordinate the team while maintaining accountability.

* Identify problems, recommend solutions, and proactively communicate progress and risks.

* Build reliable, documented, and scalable systems that improve operational efficiency and client satisfaction.





Application Requirements:

Applicants should submit an updated resume highlighting their GHL experience, examples of workflows, funnels, integrations, or CRM projects, experience in operations or team leadership, an independently solved problem or improved process, and availability with preferred working hours. Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical GHL assessment.

title: Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter
description:
Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter



Remote | Philippines



North London Massage Therapy is looking for an experienced outbound sales professional to join our team.



This is a sales role. It is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



The main purpose of your role is simple: start conversations with prospective businesses, understand their needs and book qualified meetings.



You will spend a significant part of your working time speaking to people on the phone.



What you'll be doing



- Making outbound cold and warm calls to prospective businesses

- Speaking confidently with receptionists, gatekeepers and decision-makers

- Asking good questions and actually listening to the answers

- Identifying potential needs and sales opportunities

- Handling initial objections without immediately giving up

- Communicating the value of our services clearly

- Booking qualified meetings

- Following up prospects by phone and

- Keeping accurate notes and updating our CRM

- Following up existing leads until there is a clear outcome



What we're looking for



You must have previous outbound sales, telesales, appointment-setting or business development experience.



We are looking for someone who:



- Is confident making outbound calls every day

- Can hold a natural conversation rather than simply read a script

- Understands basic sales techniques and objection handling

- Knows when to speak and, importantly, when to listen

- Can ask follow-up questions based on what a prospect actually says

- Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

- Can work independently and take ownership of follow-ups

- Has professional-level spoken and written English

- Can communicate clearly, naturally and confidently in English

- Is comfortable being coached and receiving direct feedback



Please don't apply if...



Your experience is mainly general VA work, administration, data entry or
 outreach without significant telephone sales experience.



This role requires someone who is already comfortable selling and speaking to prospects on the phone. We will provide training on our business, services and approach, but we are not looking to teach someone how to sell from scratch.



When applying



Please include:



1. A short summary of your previous outbound sales experience.

2. What you were selling and who you were calling.

3. Approximately how many outbound calls you were making per day.

4. Your experience booking appointments or meetings.

5. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you'd be good at this role.

6. Link to your updated resume or cv



Applications without relevant outbound calling experience will not be progressed.

title: Trip Operations Coordinator
description:
This is a premium group travel company 18 years strong. Every trip involves dozens of conversations: hotels to follow up with, tour operators to confirm, and scheduled guest communications that must go out on time. We are hiring a Trip Operations Coordinator to own outbound communication on both sides of a trip.



What You'll Do

On the vendor side:

Requesting information and documents from hotels and tour operators, and following up politely and persistently until items are closed

Confirming details: menus, rooming list requirements, timing, inclusions

Tracking every open question in Asana so nothing is missed

Documenting vendor responses where the team can find them

Escalating anything involving negotiation, money, contract changes, or sensitive relationships to leadership

On the guest side:

Sending scheduled trip communications on time: itineraries, reminders, and updates, usually from approved templates

Requesting missing information from guests, such as emergency contacts or travel documents, and following up until complete

Note: this role does not answer incoming guest questions; those go to our Customer Service team



What We're Looking For

Required:

Excellent spoken and written English

Professional
 writing: clear, warm, well-formatted, and consistently accurate

Confident, polite persistence: you can follow up with a hotel a third time, professionally

Judgment about what you handle and what you escalate

Organized follow-up tracking so open items never go quiet

Experience managing your assigned tasks through a project management system such as Asana; this role runs on it daily

Reliable full-time availability with full overlap of U.S. Eastern business hours, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday



Nice to have (we actively prefer these backgrounds):

Executive assistant, hospitality, hotel reservations, travel, account coordination, or vendor coordination experience

Details

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call

title: Ad Prompt Executor
description:
We’re looking for someone from the e-commerce / dropshipping world to execute ad and funnel prompts and organize the outputs in a spreadsheet.



This is NOT a data entry job. You won’t be doing data analysis, reports, or anything like that. But you DO need to understand what you’re working with. You’ll be executing prompts that generate ad creatives, ad copy, and funnel pages. If you don’t know what a sales funnel is, what Shopify is, or how
 Ads work, this role isn’t for you.



You’re not building strategy. You’re not media buying. You’re not writing copy from scratch. But you need to look at the output and know if something is obviously off before you paste the link and move on.



What you’ll be doing:

→ Receive prompts from the team that generate ad creatives, copy, and funnel content

→ Execute each prompt exactly as instructed

→ Review the output with enough e-commerce knowledge to spot obvious issues

→ Paste the output links into the correct columns in a shared spreadsheet

→ Repeat



You MUST already know what these are (not “willing to learn”):

→ Shopify

→ Sales funnels (advertorials, landing pages, checkout flows)

→
/Meta Ads (ad creatives, ad copy, campaign structure)

→ Hubstaff

→ Basic understanding of dropshipping operations



Do NOT apply if:

→ You’ve never worked in e-commerce or dropshipping

→ You don’t know what a funnel is

→ You’ve never seen the inside of Shopify or Meta Ads Manager

→ You’re about to send an application listing your SQL, Oracle, QuickBooks, and data analysis skills (we don’t need any of that)

→ You’re copy pasting the same application you sent to 50 other posts today



How to apply (read carefully):

→ Start your application with the word: velvet

→ In ONE sentence, tell us your experience with e-commerce (dropshipping, Shopify, funnels, ads, whatever you’ve actually done)

→ Your weekly availability (hours per day / days per week)

→ Confirm you’re ok with $5/hour and Hubstaff screenshots

→ Write your application yourself. If it looks like it was written by AI, it will be ignored. We’re not hiring people who can’t even apply without ChatGPT. Keep it short, keep it real, write it by hand.



AP Requirement:

→ This role has a minimum AP requirement. We will only review applications that meet our internal AP threshold. All applications below it will be automatically eliminated without being read. If you’re not serious about this role, don’t waste your points.



Pay:

→ $5/hour tracked via Hubstaff with screenshots for quality control

→ Paid test period

→ Nail the test on the first try and the rate bumps to $6/hour immediately

→ Room to grow into more responsibility if you prove yourself



Verification:

→ We’ll ask you to send a photo holding a piece of paper with a specific word we give you

→ We’ll also ask for a second photo holding a specific object of our choice to verify you’re not using AI generated images

→ Both are mandatory. If that’s a problem, don’t apply.



NDA required before starting.

About Sparkblaze Digital



Sparkblaze Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency dedicated to helping startups and growing businesses ignite growth with innovative, results-driven strategies. Our team builds and manages data-driven campaigns — from paid advertising and SEO to landing pages and conversion rate optimization — that generate measurable ROI for our clients.

We work across a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, B2B, SaaS, finance, real estate, home services, and local businesses, helping each one scale smarter and grow faster with tailored strategies. We are a fully remote team transitioning to a hybrid set-up, and we are looking for experienced, high-performing talent to help accelerate our agency's growth.



What You'll Do



As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will own the top-of-funnel of Sparkblaze Digital's sales pipeline. Your primary focus is prospecting, qualifying, and nurturing leads, then booking well-prepped discovery calls for our closing team — setting them up to convert qualified prospects into long-term agency clients. ● Prospecting and identifying potential clients who match our ideal buyer profile, primarily within the education, consulting, and other B2B service industries.

, and messaging) to build a healthy pipeline.

● Nurturing warm leads over time through consistent, personalized follow-up until they're ready for a deeper sales conversation.

● Booking discovery calls and qualified meetings for the closing team, and preparing clear handoff notes on each prospect's needs, budget, and goals.

● Accurately logging all prospect interactions, pipeline stages, and lead details in the CRM system to keep data current for the wider sales team.

● Collaborating closely with the marketing and intake teams to ensure lead quality, timely follow-through, and a smooth handoff process.

● Using CRM and AI-assisted tools to prioritize high-potential accounts and streamline outreach.

● Contributing insights from prospect conversations to help refine messaging, targeting, and outreach strategy.

● Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for qualified meetings booked and pipeline generated.



What Are We Looking For?



We are looking for a driven top-of-funnel specialist with a genuine interest in digital marketing and paid media. You don't need to be a closer — you need to be excellent at opening doors, qualifying opportunities, and setting our sales team up to win.



You should have:



● This role is also open to fresh graduates. Individuals who graduated a 4-year degree course with 1–3 years of experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), appointment setter, business development representative (BDR), or similar prospecting and lead-qualification role — agency or digital marketing experience is a plus.

● Comfort with outbound prospecting (cold calling,
ing, and social outreach) as well as qualifying inbound leads.

● Persistence and resilience — comfortable with rejection and consistent, disciplined follow-up.

● Familiarity with video conferencing and communication tools (e.g., Zoom, Slack) for booking and coordinating meetings.



Who Are We Looking For?



We are looking for A-players — individuals who are hungry, curious, and take full ownership of their pipeline goals.

● A Skilled Qualifier: Asks the right questions to quickly determine fit and surface a prospect's real needs.

● Persistent & Resilient: Keeps picking up the phone and following up, even after rejection.

● Coachable: Takes feedback well and continuously refines their outreach and qualifying approach.

● Organized & Disciplined: Detail-oriented and highly reliable in logging pipeline data and tracking follow-ups.

● Curious & Growth-Oriented: Stays on top of industry trends and is eager to grow into a closing or leadership role over time.

● A Strong Collaborator: Works closely with marketing and closers alike to keep the pipeline moving smoothly.



Why Join Sparkblaze Digital

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist - Direct hire
description:
Two things before you apply:



1. You must be able to work a U.S. Central Time (CST/CDT) schedule.

2. You must have real accounts receivable or accounting experience.



About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based outsourced accounting firm looking for a sharp, dependable Accounts Receivable Specialist to manage invoicing, payment application, collections, and outstanding customer balances across a portfolio of U.S. clients.



This is not a basic data-entry position. You will be responsible for keeping client receivables accurate, ensuring invoices are issued on time, following up on overdue payments, and identifying billing or payment issues before they become bigger problems.



You will communicate directly with U.S. clients and their customers, so strong written and spoken English, professionalism, and sound accounting judgment are essential.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, follows through without constant reminders, and understands that accurate receivables and timely collections directly affect our clients’ cash flow.



What You’ll Own



Invoicing and Billing



* Prepare and issue accurate customer invoices on schedule.

* Review billing information for completeness and accuracy before invoices are sent.

* Verify customer details, billing rates, supporting documentation, and applicable adjustments.

* Process credit memos and invoice corrections when authorized.

* Follow up on missing billing information and resolve discrepancies with clients.

* Maintain organized records of invoices and supporting documentation.



Cash Receipts and Payment Application



* Record customer payments accurately and promptly.

* Apply ACH, check, wire, and credit card payments to the correct customer invoices.

* Identify unapplied cash, short payments, overpayments, and duplicate payments.

* Research payment discrepancies and coordinate resolutions with clients.

* Reconcile customer account balances and investigate differences between accounting records and supporting reports.



Collections and AR Management



* Monitor outstanding invoices and maintain an accurate accounts receivable aging report.

* Conduct timely, professional follow-ups on overdue invoices.

* Communicate with customers regarding payment status, billing questions, and outstanding balances.

* Document collection activities, promised payment dates, and unresolved issues.

* Escalate seriously overdue accounts, disputed invoices, and collection risks promptly.

* Identify recurring late-payment patterns and recommend appropriate next steps.

* Help maintain consistent collection procedures across the client portfolio.



Reporting and Client Support



* Prepare regular AR aging, outstanding invoice, and collection status reports.

* Keep customer accounts accurate and up to date in the applicable accounting systems.

* Research and resolve discrepancies between customer records, invoices, payments, and accounting reports.

* Communicate clearly with U.S.-based clients regarding billing and collection issues.

* Meet recurring deadlines and maintain accurate documentation across multiple client accounts.

* Flag unusual transactions, potential errors, and control issues rather than making unsupported assumptions.



What We’re Looking For



* At least 2 years of hands-on accounts receivable, accounting, or billing and collections experience.

* Practical knowledge of the full AR cycle, including invoicing, cash application, aging reports, and collections.

* Experience with accounting software, preferably QuickBooks Online.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with U.S. clients.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to investigate discrepancies independently.

* Excellent organization and time-management skills when managing multiple clients and competing deadlines.

* A proactive mindset: you identify problems, follow up, and see issues through to resolution.

* Reliable internet connection, a suitable remote-work environment, and the ability to work a U.S. Central Time schedule.

* High standards for confidentiality, accuracy, and professional integrity.



Preferred qualifications:



* Experience working for a U.S.-based accounting firm, bookkeeping firm, or BPO accounting team.

* Experience managing receivables for multiple clients or businesses simultaneously.

* Familiarity with Syncore or similar accounting and workflow platforms.

* Experience with customer payment portals, AR automation tools, and collection tracking systems.



What We Offer



* Stable, full-time, long-term remote employment.

* Direct exposure to U.S. clients and real-world accounting operations.

* A collaborative team environment with clear processes and opportunities to learn.

* Training and professional development.

* Performance-based compensation reviews that recognize accuracy, accountability, and consistent results.

* Opportunities for career growth as our organization expands.



Work Schedule and Compensation



* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Employment: Full-time

* Schedule: Monday–Friday, aligned with U.S. Central Time business hours, including the applicable daylight saving time changes



How to Apply



To be considered, please include your resume and a link to a short video answering the following questions:



1. What are the two most important qualities of an effective accounts receivable specialist, and why?

2. You manage receivables for several clients, and multiple invoices are overdue. How would you prioritize your collection efforts?

3. Tell us about a real accounting, billing, or payment discrepancy you encountered. How did you investigate it, resolve it, and prevent it from happening again?



Include links to both your video and your resume in your cover letter.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career, takes pride in accurate work, communicates proactively, and can be trusted to manage responsibilities independently.



Please apply only if you have relevant hands-on experience and can consistently work the required U.S. Central Time schedule.
