title: Digital Content Designer (Canva, Social Media & Website Graphics)
description:
Role: Digital Content Designer (Canva, Social Media & Website Graphics) (Ongoing, Part-Time or Full-Time)  



Location: Remote  



Engagement: Permanent on freelance basis (employment benefits)



About The Coaches Business Studio



The Coaches Business Studio is a new online learning platform helping professional coaches build, grow and develop their coaching businesses.



While traditional coach training focuses on teaching people how to coach, we focus on helping them build the business around their coaching skills.



We're creating a growing collection of online courses, masterclasses, practical resources and other learning experiences, covering topics such as marketing, branding, finance, business development, corporate coaching and much more.



One of our distinctive features is our AI-presented faculty: a cast of virtual educators, each with their own personality, expertise and teaching style. Behind them, however, is a human team researching, writing, designing and producing the educational content.



We're building an ambitious and slightly unconventional learning platform, with a strong emphasis on quality, creativity and practical value.



Our website is already substantially developed, our video production is underway, and we're now looking for a talented graphic designer to join our small creative team.







About the Role



We're looking for a graphic designer who can become our go-to person for visual design across the Studio.



This is a hands-on creative role involving everything from social media graphics and video thumbnails to website imagery, programme artwork and educational resources.



But we're also looking for something more than straightforward graphic production.



Although we already have a logo, website, typography and colour palette, we're still developing our wider visual identity. We have some ideas about the direction we'd like to take, but we're deliberately keeping an open mind.



Rather than commissioning a large branding exercise, we'd prefer to develop our visual style organically, through experimentation, discussion and the process of creating real content.



You'll work directly with the founder, exploring ideas, presenting alternative approaches and gradually helping us establish a distinctive and consistent visual language.



We want someone who enjoys both the creative thinking and the practical design work.



What You'll Be Doing



Social Media & Marketing Graphics



Creating engaging, distinctive visual content for our social media channels, including Instagram,
, LinkedIn and YouTube.



This could include:



- Standalone graphics that communicate an idea or insight.

- Carousel posts and visual storytelling.

- Illustrations, diagrams and conceptual graphics.

- Promotional images for courses and other Studio content.

- Graphics to accompany articles, essays and educational posts.

- Campaign visuals and advertising creatives.



We're particularly interested in graphics that communicate ideas intelligently, rather than simply decorating a quote or adding text to a stock photograph.



Website & Digital Design



Developing visual assets for our existing website and helping refine its visual presentation.



This may include:



- Imagery and illustrations for website pages.

- Visual identities for our different learning formats.

- Icons and supporting graphic elements.

- Programme artwork and promotional banners.

- Suggestions for improving the visual consistency and personality of the site.



We're not looking for someone to rebuild the website. The focus is on creating the visual assets and design treatments that make it more distinctive and engaging.



Video Thumbnails & Programme Artwork



Designing thumbnails and covers for YouTube videos, online courses, masterclasses and other educational content.



We want these to feel part of a recognisable Studio identity while giving individual subjects and faculty members their own character.



You'll work alongside our video production team to ensure a consistent approach across video and graphic content.



Educational Resources



Helping create visually attractive, clear and useful learning materials.



These may include:



- Workbook covers and internal page designs.

- Diagrams, models and frameworks.

- Worksheets, templates and downloadable resources.

- Presentation graphics.

- Supporting illustrations for educational content.



The emphasis will be on good information design, clarity and usability as well as visual appeal.



Developing Our Visual Identity



A particularly interesting part of the role will be helping shape the Studio's visual direction.



We don't expect you to arrive with a complete brand strategy or disappear for several weeks to produce a formal branding presentation.



Instead, we'd like to work collaboratively.



We might explore a particular illustration style, create several treatments of a website section, experiment with different approaches to course covers, or develop a family of graphics for our social media content.



Through this process, we'll identify what works, refine our preferences and gradually build a consistent visual identity.



Over time, we'd like you to help document the decisions we've made, creating a straightforward visual guide and reusable templates for the team.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for a talented, imaginative graphic designer with strong visual judgement and a genuine interest in creative collaboration.



Ideally, you'll have:



- An excellent portfolio demonstrating strong graphic design skills.

- A good eye for typography, composition, colour and visual hierarchy.

- Experience creating content for social media and digital platforms.

- The ability to communicate ideas through illustrations, graphics and visual concepts.

- Experience creating coherent designs across different formats.

- Confidence using professional design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud and/or Figma.

- The ability to develop ideas independently and present different creative options.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce polished, finished work.

- An organised and reliable approach to managing ongoing assignments.



Experience with editorial design, educational content, brand design or information design would be particularly valuable.



We're also happy for you to use AI-assisted creative tools where they genuinely improve the work, provided you bring your own design judgement and attention to quality.



The Kind of Working Relationship We Want



We're a small team, and we work collaboratively.



You'll work directly with the founder, who is closely involved in the creative direction of the Studio, as well as alongside our video editors and content production team.



We're looking for someone who is comfortable with an iterative process: discussing an idea, producing a few approaches, getting feedback, refining the design and moving forward.



Sometimes we'll have a very clear brief. At other times, we'll have a half-formed idea and want your help developing it.



You should feel comfortable making suggestions, questioning an approach and proposing something better.



We value good creative judgement, curiosity, initiative and the willingness to experiment.



We also want someone who enjoys producing finished work. This isn't primarily a consultancy or brand strategy position. It's a creative production role with the opportunity to help influence the brand's direction.



What Success Looks Like



Over the first few months, we'd hope to see:



- A regular flow of high-quality visual content for our social media channels.

- An increasingly consistent and recognisable style across our visual materials.

- Stronger and more distinctive website imagery.

- A coherent approach to course covers and video thumbnails.

- A growing collection of reusable templates and design assets.

- A productive creative relationship in which ideas can be explored and developed quickly.



We expect our visual identity to become clearer through this process rather than trying to settle every decision before the work begins.

What We're Offering



This is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing creative and educational business.



You'll have the chance to contribute ideas, influence the development of the brand and see your work used across a wide range of channels and educational products.



We're interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person.



We're open to discussing the number of hours and working arrangements depending on your experience and availability.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your portfolio, particularly examples of social media graphics, editorial design, digital graphics, illustrations or brand-related work.

2. A short introduction explaining what kinds of design work you particularly enjoy and why this role interests you.



We'd particularly like to see examples where you've taken a relatively simple idea and turned it into an original, engaging visual.



Please avoid lengthy, generic proposals and AI written smartly worded applications that I get 10 times per day. We'd much rather see a strong portfolio and a few thoughtful comments about how you like to work.



We're looking for someone who can help us create the Studio's visual identity by making things, experimenting and improving together.

Why this role is worth your time:

• You do not need to find your own leads

• There is a clear paid path from training to live calls and long-term work

• Base pay plus uncapped commissions rewards both consistency and results



Schedule:

• Monday-Friday only; no weekend calling

• 9:00 AM-1:00 PM in the local U.S. time zone assigned to your leads

• Four consecutive hours per day

• This normally means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines, depending on the assigned U.S. territory



Your responsibilities:

• Make 200 calls per day during your four-hour calling shift (50 calls per hour), both during the live trial and regular work

• Speak naturally and confidently with wedding photographers and studio owners

• Explain EditValue clearly and offer one complimentary wedding reel

• Ask useful questions, identify decision-makers, and follow up with interested studios

• Accurately record dispositions and notes in the CRM

Compensation after successfully completing the live trial:

• $480/month guaranteed base

• $20 for every qualified wedding studio that submits wedding footage

• Unlimited commissions



Your clear path into the role:

Initial application screening - Submit the short mock-call voice audition below, followed by the unpaid SDR scenario test if invited. This screening is separate from the five paid bootcamp stages.



1. SDR101 - Knowledge ($2): Learn EditValue’s service, the complimentary-reel offer, listening, and objection handling.

2. SDR102 - Voice Readiness ($5): Practice clear, warm, assured delivery and receive coaching through simulated conversations.

3. SDR103 - Call Training ($10): Complete and submit all 25 training calls, applying the feedback after each call.

4. SDR104 - Validation ($5): Complete a fresh assessment to demonstrate what you learned and how your performance improved.

5. SDR105 - One-Day Live Trial ($10): After approval and scheduling, use our dialer, CRM, and leads for a supervised live calling trial.



The five stages offer $32 in total. Stage completion, verification, and qualification are reviewed separately; payment is not automatic. We provide the applicable completion and payment-request instructions at each stage. Advancement requires meeting that stage’s requirements.



Longer-term opportunity - Strong performers may advance to further evaluation and ongoing employment.



Payments during the assessment process are made through PayPal, so you must be able to receive PayPal payments.



Who will do well:

• Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

• Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

• Previous B2B, SDR, appointment-setting, or cold-calling experience is preferred

• Coachable, reliable, and willing to apply feedback quickly

• Comfortable working the stated U.S. hours

• Reliable computer, internet connection, and microphone

• Consistent, accurate CRM use



Learn about the service before applying: 



How to apply:

Send a 15-25 second voice recording.



Imagine Amanda, a wedding photography studio owner, just answered your call.

Deliver this opening like a skilled actor making the conversation feel real - with confidence, warmth, and clarity:



“Hi Amanda, I’m [Your name]. I help wedding studios catch up on editing. Do you need a hand with your highlight films or wedding reels?”



Smile as you speak. Sound assured and conversational, then end the recording.



While you record, make sure to avoid a dry reading, rushed words, a hesitant tone, or speaking too softly.



Perform the opening - not a self-introduction about your background.



Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: AU Senior Tax Accountant
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



- CPA qualification is a BIG PLUS.

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



TOOLS



Xero | Xero Tax | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)



EMPLOYEE BENEFITS



- Independent Contractor (no payroll deductions)

- 100% reimbursed government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG) — you pay your contributions directly, and you will be reimbursed the full amount, so there is no deduction from your salary

- 13th-month pay

- HMO coverage

- Paid leaves and paid holidays

- Fully remote setup



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your résumé and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Ecom Graphic designer
description:
We’re a fast-growing skincare brand looking for a talented graphic designer who is also a strong writer.



You’ll be creating static ad creatives across the full marketing funnel — from top-of-funnel scroll-stoppers, to mid-funnel ads that address objections and build trust, to bottom-of-funnel creatives focused on offers, urgency, and conversion. Your work should consistently reflect our brand identity, products, messaging, and current promotions.



Strong writing skills are just as important as strong design skills. Long-form advertorials and listicles are a key part of our advertising strategy, so you should be comfortable researching products and topics independently, turning that research into clear and persuasive copy, and pairing it with compelling, native-style visuals.



Accuracy and attention to detail are extremely important to us. Nothing gets published unless the information, copy, design, and overall message are correct and polished.



Competitive Research



As part of the role, you’ll also help us stay ahead of the market by:



Monitoring competitor ads through the
 Ad Library and other relevant platforms



Identifying trending ad formats, hooks, angles, and creative approaches within the skincare, health, and supplement spaces



Providing insights into what appears to be working for similar brands, particularly those targeting mothers



Staying up to date with platform-specific creative best practices and emerging advertising trends



Using your research to inspire new creative concepts rather than simply copying what competitors are doing



Requirements



We’re looking for someone who has:



Strong static ad design skills using Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar tools



Excellent written English, with the ability to write clearly, persuasively, and accurately



The ability to independently research a product, audience, or topic before creating content



A strong eye for layout, hierarchy, branding, typography, and attention-grabbing creative



High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy



The ability to take feedback and turn it into stronger creative work



An understanding of funnel stages — TOF, MOF, and BOF — and how creative and messaging should differ across them is a plus, but it’s not essential. We can show you how we approach this internally.



For us, quality and accuracy matter more than simply producing work as quickly as possible.



What Happens After You Apply



If your application looks like a good fit, we’ll send you our website along with a selection of example creatives so you can get a better understanding of our brand, products, and advertising style.



We’ll then ask you to create a 15USD paid task, where you will create 3-5, original static ad concept, including the copy, to show us how you would approach similar content for our brand.



This is not intended to be a large or time-consuming test. We simply want to get a feel for your creative thinking, design style, copywriting ability, and overall process before d
 on the next step.



If you’re equally comfortable thinking about why an ad should work, writing the message, and turning that message into a strong visual, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Ecom AI Video Editor — Direct-Response Supplement Mini VSL Ads (Higgsfield / Kling / Nano Banana)
description:
We're an established, fast-growing US direct-response health-supplement brand. Our marketing runs on short-form VSL-style video ads — the 2–3 minute "mini-VSL" format where a single on-camera authority walks the viewer from a problem, to the real root cause, to the solution. It's a proven, high-volume ad engine, and video is the core of it.



We're looking for an AI video editor to join us long-term and own the visual build of these ads. This isn't a "cut what you're told" role — you'll take a script and a talking-head and turn it into a finished, fast-paced ad end to end, bringing your own ideas for how each beat should look. You'll be fully supported (accounts, credits, assets, and direction all provided), and the right person will be paid well — above average.



What you'll do:



Own the full visual build of our DR supplement VSL ads (~2–2.5 min mini-VSLs).

Take a talking-head photo (which you generate) + the script, and build everything else: all b-rolls, any supporting images, and the full edit — which clip goes where, pacing, clean j-cuts.

Concept the visuals yourself — d
 how each section (especially the root-cause and solution beats) should be shown.



Hard requirements:



Heavy experience editing for DR (direct-response) supplement brands — the longer mini-VSL style, not light branding work. This is required.

Daily hands-on with AI tools — you use Higgsfield and AI image/video generation every day, and your output looks genuinely realistic (not obviously "AI"). Show us realistic AI images and AI video you've made.

You ideate and build the visuals yourself — we bring the script, talking-head, and AI tools; d
 how every beat looks is on you.

You can own the entire ad's visuals end-to-end (b-rolls, images, sequencing, pacing).



Strongly preferred (big plus — not required):



At least one of these actually in your reel: Suno-style song-driven ads, claymation ads, or Pixar-style character animation.



Tools (we provide access + credits): Higgsfield, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana 2.



📩 How to Apply:



Attach your portfolio / best work — ideally ads you've made for DR-heavy supplement brands. In your message, tell us: (1) whether you've done at least one of — Suno song ads, Pixar-style, or claymation (preferred, not required); and (2) whether you can take care of the entire ad visuals yourself (we provide the Higgsfield account + credits, a talking-head photo, and the script; you handle all b-rolls and any images).

- **Demonstrated experience creating AI-generated video content**

- Experience creating realistic **AI UGC-style videos**

- Strong understanding of what makes AI-generated footage look authentic versus obviously artificial

- Strong understanding of Instagram, Instagram Reels and short-form social content

- Experience editing content for
, Instagram and TikTok

- Experience creating direct-response advertisements designed to generate sales

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention and storytelling

- Ability to match reference videos and recreate specific creative styles

- Strong proficiency with professional video editing software

- Experience working with modern AI video generation tools and workflows

title: Executive Assistant to a Fast-Growing CEO (Inbox, Calendar, Travel, Personal Admin)
description:

THE ROLE

- Calendar: Schedule and color-code all meetings, keep calls to 20 minutes with 10-minute buffers, and group meetings together so I get full days free for deep work. Every invite should include the context I need.

- Travel: Book flights, hotels, and transport to my preferences, build a trip file for each trip, check me in, and handle delays right away.

- Personal admin: Book recurring appointments (haircuts, boxing sessions, cleaners), personal purchases, and gifts for clients, friends, and family.

- Projects and follow-up: Track key projects and deadlines, follow up after my meetings, and be the link between me and my team.

- Daily rhythm: Plan your day each morning, send an end-of-day update, and run a short agenda meeting with me (daily at first, then less often as you ramp up).



WHO YOU ARE

- 2+ years as an executive or personal assistant to a founder or senior leader

- Excellent written English. You'll be
ing people as my representative.

- Very organized and detail-oriented. Nothing falls through the cracks.

- Proactive. You suggest better ways of doing things without being asked.

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) and Slack

- Trustworthy with confidential business and personal information

- Available during my working hours (roughly 1 PM - 7 PM Dubai time, which is 5 PM - 11 PM in the Philippines) with some flexibility around them



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience booking international travel and working with a CEO in the Middle East or Europe

- Experience with US-based businesses



WHAT YOU GET

- Long-term, full-time role with a founder who will invest in you

- Clear SOPs and direct mentorship from me

- Room to grow as the company scales



HOW TO APPLY

3. Your available working hours (Philippine time)



Applications without "Zero Inbox" at the top won't be reviewed.

Remote



Initially part-time, with the possibility of increased hours based on project volume and performance

Ongoing project-based work available for strong performers

Documentation and QA/QC habits

BIM/CAD software you have used



Years of experience, if any

title: CRO Consultant
description:
We're seeking a Conversion Strategist to fulfil a vital role in the delivery of CRO projects, from identifying optimisation opportunities using analysis and research to implementing and measuring split test experiments.



This job role is an excellent opportunity to join an tech startup and digital agency.



The successful candidate will sit within the CRO team and report to the Management Team. They will work closely with the wider team to define and deliver impactful strategies and testing programmes for our clients.



 This role requires an individual who is a team player, well organised, with high attention to detail, who is prepared to build trust through hard work, effective communication and a desire to learn. 



You'll need to have a passion for delivering exceptional experiences to users, but you'll also appreciate the value of using data and real user feedback to support your ideas. You'll need to be prepared to experiment and learn. You don't see blockers where others might; you see opportunities to innovate around them.



What you'll be doing…

You'll work with our clients and be supported by a fantastic team and work together to analyse, understand and solve conversion problems and realise objectives.



You'll identify and conceptualise solutions to conversion problems, split test them and report on how awesome your ideas proved to be. For this, you will need to:



Analyse, hypothesize and prioritise



Interrogate data and user behaviour to build a true picture of performance across any given user journey

Uncover the 'why' behind an issue by evaluating user experiences and by gathering real user feedback from user testing (delivered by working with our user research team)

Pool results from analysis and research to construct informed and high-quality hypotheses that recommend solutions to remove blockers and/or enhance persuasive signals

Prioritise hypotheses by assessing and scoring them objectively against various criteria

Implement experiments



Work with designers, developers and project managers to implement experiments efficiently and effectively – creating design briefs, attending ideation workshops, creating simple mock-ups and writing test requirement briefs that communicate all aspects of a test

Set up robust split tests using a testing platform, carry out quality assurance testing and launch safely

Learn from results, report and refine



Monitor the progress of tests, interpret results using sound statistical analysis and draw additional critical insight by deep-diving segment data

Report to clients and internal stakeholders on the progress and results of experiments, providing clients with accurate and understandable recommendations and reports

Refine and develop optimisation strategies in line with client goals and changes in their environment

Maintain and develop client relationships to meet/exceed KPI targets

What you'll bring



Essential experience and skillset



Experience working in an online or digital role (agency or client-side)

Experience with web analytics tools and able to draw insights from data

Data analysis and manipulation skills, e.g. using MS Excel, Google Sheets etc.

An understanding of the core principles of CRO and UX and how they can be applied to web properties to improve performance

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Excellent time management and organisation

Self-motivated to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment

High attention to detail

Analytical yet creative

Passionate about the industry, willing to learn and actively keeps their knowledge up-to-date



Desirable



Working knowledge of Google Analytics

Experience in evaluating user experiences or involvement in user testing projects

Knowledge or experience in using a testing platform to run split tests

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery would be beneficial but not essential

Comfortable communicating complex technical solutions to a mixed audience with varying levels of understanding

Experience in creating innovative and elegant web solutions to resolve conversion or usability issues

Experience and involvement in website development projects

Experience using statistical methods to interpret conversion test results

Experience in working with businesses of various sizes, including national or international

Experience in presenting pitches/proposals and reports to a senior stakeholder team or clients

title: Senior Tax Accountant (Australia)
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



- CPA qualification is a BIG PLUS.

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



TOOLS



Xero | Xero Tax | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)



EMPLOYEE BENEFITS



* Independent Contractor (no payroll deductions)

* 100% reimbursed government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG) — you pay your contributions directly, and you will be reimbursed the full amount, so there is no deduction from your salary

* 13th-month pay

* HMO coverage

* Paid leaves and paid holidays

* Fully remote setup



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your résumé and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor (TikTok, Reels & Meta Ads)
description:
**Hiring: Short-Form UGC Video Editor**



I'm a full-time UGC content creator working with brands to produce short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta advertising.



I'm looking for someone who is a fast communicator, reliable, creative video editor who can help me produce high-quality videos consistently with a fast turnaround time.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Editing short-form UGC videos, typically 15–60 seconds

- Adding captions, B-roll, key framing, overlays, and sound effects when appropriate

- Creating multiple video variations using different hooks, bodies, and CTAs

- Following my existing editing style while bringing your own creative ideas

- Organizing finished videos and project files in Google Drive

- Delivering edits consistently and making revisions when needed



**Workload & Compensation**



- Starting pay: $100 USD per week

- Target output: Up to 50 short-form video exports per week, including variations

- Flexible working hours

- Opportunity for a long-term working relationship

- Compensation and workload may be adjusted as the business grows



**What I'm Looking For**



- Experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or UGC ads

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and viewer retention

- Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

- Good English comprehension

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



**HOW TO APPLY**



I care more about your editing ability than your resume.



To be considered, you'll need to complete two short editing assessments.



**TEST 1: Recreate My Video**



I'll provide a Google Drive folder containing a finished video and its raw footage.



Your task is to recreate the finished video as closely as possible, including cuts, captions, pacing, and overlays.



**TEST 2: Create Your Own Edit**



I'll provide separate raw footage, B-roll, and other assets.



I want to see how you think creatively, not just how well you can copy.



**SUBMISSION**



Send your portfolio, the editing software you use, and a brief introduction explaining your short-form editing experience.



Shortlisted applicants will receive the editing assessment instructions.



I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with me long-term, not just complete a one-time project.

title: Branded Merchandise Sales Manager
description:
Brand Bros is looking for a dependable, organized, creative, and sales-minded Branded Merchandise Sales Manager to lead our promotional products business.



This person will manage the entire order process, from generating leads and helping customers select the right products to preparing artwork, coordinating production, tracking orders, and confirming final delivery. They will also help grow this area of our business through inbound lead follow-up, cold calling, email outreach, and relationship-building.



This is a full-time, remote position. For someone who is motivated and successful in generating new business, there is substantial opportunity to increase their earnings through commission.



Responsibilities Include:

- Sales and Business Development

- Respond promptly to inbound leads and customer inquiries.

- Conduct cold calls, email outreach, and follow-ups with prospective customers.

- Build relationships with current customers and identify opportunities for repeat business.

- Learn about each customer’s needs, goals, audience, budget, quantity, and timeline.

- Recommend branded merchandise that supports the customer’s goals.

- Prepare quotes and consistently follow up to close sales.

- Maintain accurate records of leads, customer conversations, quotes, and sales activity.

- Identify new opportunities to grow Brand Bros’ branded merchandise business.

- Product Research and Sourcing

- Search our online database of approximately 100,000 promotional products.

- Find products that meet each customer’s budget, deadline, quantity, and branding needs.

- Contact vendors to confirm pricing, inventory, production timelines, shipping costs, and decoration options.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors.

- Identify reliable products and suppliers that offer the best combination of quality, price, and turnaround time.

- Present customers with clear, well-organized product recommendations.

- Use industry platforms such as CommonSku and ASI to research products, prepare quotes, manage orders, and maintain customer information.

- Artwork and Production Setup

- Collect customer logos, brand guidelines, artwork files, imprint requirements, and other necessary materials.

- Use Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or similar design tools to prepare product artwork and mockups.

- Resize, adjust, and prepare customer logos for different products and decoration methods.

- Confirm that artwork meets vendor specifications before it is submitted for production.

- Coordinate with Brand Bros and contract graphic designers when more advanced design assistance is needed.

- Submit artwork to vendors and manage the proofing and approval process.

- Review proofs carefully for logo placement, colors, sizing, spelling, and overall accuracy.

- Obtain customer approval before an order enters production.

- Experience preparing artwork for embroidery, screen printing, direct-to-garment printing, heat transfer, engraving, sublimation, or other decoration methods is preferred.

- Order and Project Management

- Manage every branded merchandise order from the initial request through final delivery.

- Place orders accurately and verify all product, quantity, color, size, imprint, pricing, and shipping details.

- Monitor production schedules and shipping timelines.

- Keep customers informed about the status of their orders.

- Quickly address artwork, inventory, production, vendor, or shipping issues.

- Confirm that completed orders are delivered correctly and on time.

- Coordinate vendor invoices and ensure they are submitted for payment.

- Follow up with customers after delivery to confirm satisfaction and identify reorder opportunities.

- Maintain complete and accurate documentation for every order.





Qualifications

The ideal candidate will be:



- Proficient in spoken and written English.

- Available Monday - Friday from 9am - 5pm EST

- Comfortable speaking with customers

- Proficient in using CommonSku (REQUIRED)

- Experience using GoHighLevel

- Comfortable using Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or similar design software. (REQUIRED)

- Professional, friendly, and confident in customer communications.

- Highly organized and capable of managing multiple orders and deadlines.

- Detail-oriented, particularly when reviewing pricing, quantities, artwork, proofs, and shipping information.

- Sales-minded and motivated to generate and close new business.

- Proactive about following up, communicating, and solving problems.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

- Able to prepare basic product artwork, mockups, and production-ready files.

- Comfortable using email, spreadsheets, online research tools, CRM software, and order-management platforms.

- Reliable, responsive, and accountable.

- Experience with CommonSku, ASI, promotional products, branded merchandise, apparel decoration, printing, sales, customer service, account management, or order fulfillment is required.



Required Hours:

Monday through Friday from 9am until 5pm EST



Compensation and Growth

- Base pay of $6 to $8 per hour based on experience

- Additional commission based on an agreed-upon commission structure.

- Substantial earning potential for someone who consistently generates and closes new business.

Brand Bros is a full-service branding, marketing, and public relations agency. We help businesses and organizations strengthen their brands through creative strategy, thoughtful execution, and branded merchandise that keeps them visible.
